# Android chat-app UI/UX + theming 2026 — deep research

Note: the `websearch_cited` backend was unconfigured in this session, so this is built from primary sources instead: Context7 docs (M3, Compose, Stream, Coil, mikepenz), plus direct fetches of [unifiedpush.org](https://unifiedpush.org), [docs.ntfy.sh](https://docs.ntfy.sh), [GetStream docs](https://getstream.io/chat/docs/sdk/android/compose/overview/), and the relevant GitHub repos. Every URL below was either fetched live this session or is a stable canonical URL.

## 1. Material 3 Expressive + edge-to-edge + adaptive + dynamic type

**M3 Expressive.** The current API surface (per [m3.material.io/blog/m3-expressive-motion-theming](https://m3.material.io/blog/m3-expressive-motion-theming)):
- Dependency: `androidx.compose.material3:material3:1.4.0-alpha11` (Expressive APIs move to 1.5.0-alphaX once 1.4.0 goes stable).
- Theme entry point is `MaterialExpressiveTheme(colorScheme, motionScheme, shapes, typography, content)` with `motionScheme = MotionScheme.expressive()` or `.standard()` — set once, all components inherit.
- New components: `ButtonGroup` (connected/overflow variants), `LoadingIndicator` (for `PullToRefreshBox`), wider shape morphing, spring-based `MotionScheme` you can override per-spec (`defaultEffectsSpec`, `defaultSpatialSpec`, fast/slow variants). Custom components should animate with `MaterialTheme.motionScheme.defaultSpatialSpec()` / `defaultEffectsSpec()` so they follow the theme.
- Expressive color: keep using dynamic color (`dynamicDarkColorScheme`/`dynamicLightColorScheme`) — Expressive is additive (motion+shape+emphasis), not a replacement color system.
- Catalog/demo: [meticha/material-3-expressive-catalog](https://github.com/meticha/material-3-expressive-catalog), [emertozd/compose-material-3-expressive-catalog](https://github.com/emertozd/compose-material-3-expressive-catalog).

**Edge-to-edge.** Mandatory posture for 2026: Android 15 enforces edge-to-edge for `targetSdk 35+`; there is no opt-out via `windowOptOutEdgeToEdgeEnforcement` except narrow legacy cases.
- Call `enableEdgeToEdge()` in `Activity.onCreate()` ([docs](https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/system/setup-e2e)).
- Do NOT blanket-apply `Modifier.safeDrawingPadding()` at root — that defeats edge-to-edge. Apply insets per-screen/per-component: `Modifier.windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing)`, `imePadding()` on the composer, `navigationBarsPadding()` on bottom bars, `statusBarsPadding()` on top bars. Chat-specific: message list draws behind nav bar (scrim or transparent), composer sits above IME via `WindowInsets.ime`.
- 3-button nav still gets a translucent scrim automatically; gesture nav is fully transparent.

**Adaptive (phone/foldable/tablet).**
- `androidx.compose.material3.adaptive`: `ListDetailPaneScaffold` (conversation list → thread, the canonical chat pattern), `SupportingPaneScaffold`, `NavigableListDetailPaneScaffold` — these preserve state across form-factor changes (positional-memoization safe). Drive with `currentWindowAdaptiveInfo()` / `WindowSizeClass`.
- Foldables: `androidx.window` (`WindowInfoTracker`) for hinge/folding features; avoid putting the composer under a hinge — use `WindowInsetsRulers` / hinge-aware padding.
- Canonical guidance: [developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/build-adaptive-apps](https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/build-adaptive-apps).

**Dynamic type.** Compose `sp` units follow system font scale automatically; test at 200% scale. Rules: never hardcode `dp` heights on text containers, use `Modifier.heightIn(min=)` + flexible layouts, don't cap `fontScale` (capping breaks accessibility audits), verify bubble widths with longest-locale strings (German) at max scale.

**Cyberpunk/neon dark theme tokens (concrete recipe).** Define two `ColorScheme`s and pass into `MaterialExpressiveTheme(colorScheme = ...)`:
- `background #05010F`, `surface #0B0620`, `surfaceContainer*` ramp on deep violet; `primary #00F0FF` (cyan neon), `secondary #B537F2` (magenta), `tertiary #39FF14` (acid green, sparing — timestamps, online dots); `error #FF2A6D`.
- Neon glow without custom draw code: `Modifier.shadow(elevation, spotColor = primary)` + `graphicsLayer` on expressive springs; or a `drawBehind` bloom for the send button. Keep `onPrimary/onSurface` at ≥4.5:1 — neon-on-black passes easily, neon-on-neon doesn't.
- Pair with `MotionScheme.expressive()` springs and an expressive `Shapes` (large rounded = 28dp+ bubbles) for the cyberpunk-soft look.

## 2. Chat UI libraries: native Compose vs cross-platform

**Native (recommended for this use case).**
| Need | Library | URL |
|---|---|---|
| Full chat UI (Compose) | Stream Chat Compose v7: `ChannelScreen`/`MessageList`/`MessageComposer`, `ChatTheme(componentFactory=…)` for customization | [getstream.io/chat/docs/sdk/android/compose/overview](https://getstream.io/chat/docs/sdk/android/compose/overview/) · [github.com/GetStream/stream-chat-android](https://github.com/GetStream/stream-chat-android) |
| Markdown incl. code blocks | mikepenz multiplatform-markdown-renderer (`-m3` module + `-code` module for Highlights-based syntax highlighting w/ language header + copy button) | [github.com/mikepenz/multiplatform-markdown-renderer](https://github.com/mikepenz/multiplatform-markdown-renderer) |
| Streaming (token-by-token) markdown | Same lib: `rememberStreamingMarkdownState()` + `append(chunk)`, or `Flow.collectAsStreamingMarkdownState()` — re-parses only the unstable tail | same repo, `Streaming` section of README (verified live) |
| Image attach/render | Coil 3 `AsyncImage` (`io.coil-kt.coil3:coil-compose:3.6.0`); markdown lib has `-coil3` transformer (`Coil3ImageTransformerImpl`) | [coil-kt.github.io/coil](https://coil-kt.github.io/coil/compose) |
| Camera capture | CameraX (`androidx.camera:camera-camera2/lifecycle/view`) + `ActivityResultContracts.TakePicture()`; gallery via Android 13+ Photo Picker (`PickVisualMedia`) — no storage permission needed | [developer.android.com/media/camera/camerax](https://developer.android.com/media/camera/camerax) |
| Voice input | Platform `SpeechRecognizer` / `RecognizerIntent.ACTION_RECOGNIZE_SPEECH` — no library needed; stream partial results into the composer | [developer.android.com/reference/android/speech/SpeechRecognizer](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/speech/SpeechRecognizer) |
| Voice *messages* (record/play) | Stream SDK has audio-recording guide; else `MediaRecorder` + `ExoPlayer`/`Media3` | [getstream.io XML voice-recording guide](https://getstream.io/chat/docs/sdk/android/ui/guides/enabling-audio-recording/) |
| Haptics | `LocalHapticFeedback.current.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType…)` — `LongPress`, `TextHandleMove`, `Confirm` on send, `Reject` on error | [developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/touch-input](https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/touch-input) |

Notes: Stream is a hosted backend (self-hostable only at enterprise tier) — if the chat backend itself must be self-hosted, use Stream's UI components for reference only and pair the markdown/Coil/CameraX stack above with your own backend. The old `mikepenz/markdown-compose` repo name is dead (404) — the maintained artifact is `multiplatform-markdown-renderer`. Alternatives: [jeziellago/compose-markdown](https://github.com/jeziellago/compose-markdown), [feiyin0719/ComposeMarkdown](https://github.com/feiyin0719/ComposeMarkdown).

**Cross-platform.** [KevinnZou/compose-webview-multiplatform](https://github.com/KevinnZou/compose-webview-multiplatform) (WebView in shared Compose code, JS bridge `kmpJsBridge`), mikepenz renderer is KMP (Android/iOS/Desktop/Web from one call), Stream ships Flutter/React Native SDKs. Verdict: for an Android-first agent-observation app with CDP/VNC embedding, go native — the embedding APIs (WebView, foreground services, autofill) are all platform-specific anyway; share only the markdown renderer if iOS ever matters.

## 3. Self-hosted push without Firebase

Three-layer decision: **(a)** push *protocol* lib in-app, **(b)** always-on transport fallback, **(c)** exposure via Cloudflare.

**(a) Protocol options.**
| Option | What it is | Repos/docs |
|---|---|---|
| **UnifiedPush** (recommended) | Open protocol; app embeds `android-connector`, user picks a distributor (ntfy / Sunup / NextPush / Conversations). Server side speaks standard Web Push (RFC 8291 `aes128gcm` + optional VAPID RFC 8292). Encrypted, de-Googlable, works via F-Droid | [unifiedpush.org](https://unifiedpush.org) · [android-connector](https://github.com/UnifiedPush/android-connector) · [implementations](https://unifiedpush.org/developers/implementations/) · [intro](https://unifiedpush.org/developers/intro/) |
| **ntfy direct** | Self-host `ntfy` server, app subscribes per topic: `GET /topic/json` (NDJSON, recommended), `/topic/sse` (EventSource), `/topic/ws` (WebSocket). Built-in `since=` replay, `poll=1`, priorities, auth, attachments, keepalive events | [github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy](https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy) · [subscribe API](https://docs.ntfy.sh/subscribe/api/) · [self-host](https://docs.ntfy.sh/install/) |
| **Gotify direct** | Self-host `gotify/server` (Go, REST + WebSocket stream, web UI, plugins); official Android app reference for foreground-service pattern | [github.com/gotify/server](https://github.com/gotify/server) · [github.com/gotify/android](https://github.com/gotify/android) |

Recommendation: **UnifiedPush with ntfy-as-distributor** — one integration gets you both the user-choice story and ntfy's self-hosted server; fall back to embedded `embedded_fcm_distributor` only if you ever accept Play Services. Pure-ntfy-direct is simpler if you control both ends and don't need distributor choice.

**(b) Always-on transport (the hard part without FCM).** No push standard survives Doze/OEM killers by itself:
- Run a `foregroundServiceType="remoteMessaging"` (Android 14+) foreground service holding the ntfy SSE/WS or UnifiedPush distributor connection; ntfy sends `keepalive` events — use them as the connection health signal.
- You MUST route users through a battery-optimization exemption flow (`REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS` intent) — Gotify documents exactly this plus `dontkillmyapp.com` per-OEM steps. Minimize the persistent notification via channel importance (Android 8+), as Gotify's README describes.
- Cache + replay server-side (`since=<last-id>`) so gaps from Doze windows backfill on reconnect.

**(c) Cloudflare Tunnel / Access tradeoffs.**
- **Tunnel** ([docs](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/networks/connectors/cloudflare-tunnel/)): `cloudflared` makes outbound-only connections — no inbound ports, no public IP. This is how your ntfy/Gotify/WebSocket origin is reachable. WebSockets are fully supported through tunnels.
- **Access** (Zero Trust in front): adds IdP login — wrong default for machine clients. Your app's SSE/WS must then send `CF-Access-Client-Id`/`CF-Access-Client-Secret` service-token headers on every connection, and token rotation becomes your problem. Prefer: keep push endpoints on a tunnel hostname *without* Access, protected by ntfy/Gotify's own auth (Basic/tokens) + unguessable topic names; put Access only on the human web UI. If Access is mandatory, use service tokens, not interactive login, and test reconnect + `since=` replay through it.
- Watch idle timeouts on long-lived SSE through any proxy — prefer the `/ws` or `/json` endpoints with keepalives and client-side reconnect with backoff.

## 4. In-app browser embedding: WebView vs VNC vs CDP relay

For "observe the agent's browser" (your Playwright/Chrome-extension setup):

| Approach | Fit | Key facts |
|---|---|---|
| **WebView** | Best for *rendering pages inside the chat app* (login pages, agent-view snapshots) | `androidx.webkit`, JS bridge via `addJavascriptInterface` / `WebViewCompat`; Compose wrapper: [KevinnZou/compose-webview](https://github.com/KevinnZou/compose-webview) (Android) — Accompanist's web module is deprecated, don't build on it. Full DOM control, no pixels-over-wire. Cannot attach to an *external* Chrome. |
| **VNC client** | Only if the agent runs a full remote desktop | No maintained first-party Compose VNC widget; you'd embed [noVNC](https://github.com/novnc/noVNC) in a WebView (VNC→WebSocket→canvas). Heavy: full desktop encode, no DOM semantics, painful input mapping. Avoid unless the agent box is VNC-only. |
| **CDP relay (recommended)** | Best for *observing + driving an external agent Chrome* | Chrome on the box runs `--remote-debugging-port`; expose via Cloudflare Tunnel; app holds a WebSocket to `/json` and speaks CDP: `Page.startScreencast` for live MJPEG-ish observation, `Input.dispatchMouseEvent`/`dispatchKeyEvent` for control, `Runtime.evaluate` for Playwright-style queries. Transport with OkHttp WebSocket + kotlinx.serialization; optional JVM client [kklisura/chrome-devtools-java-client](https://github.com/kklisura/chrome-devtools-java-client). This mirrors your existing CDP-bridge architecture and keeps DOM-level control Playwright/extension flows need. |

**Password-entry handoff UX (concrete pattern).**
1. Never type passwords into the CDP-screencast view or a plain WebView and never log keystrokes — flag the observation surface `FLAG_SECURE` so screencast frames can't be screenshotted by other apps.
2. Detect a password field (CDP `DOM.describeNode` / focus event on `input[type=password]`, or WebView URL heuristic for known IdPs) → pause agent input, show a bottom-sheet: "Agent needs your login for *host*".
3. Hand off credential *entry* to the system: open the login URL in a **Custom Tab** (`androidx.browser`) — user gets their own cookies, Android Autofill, and passkeys — then deep-link back (`app://auth-callback`) and signal the agent session to resume. Fallback inside-app: a native `CredentialManager` (passkey/password) sheet that fills via CDP `DOM.setAttributeValue` without ever displaying the secret in chat.
4. Post-login, show explicit "control returned to agent" state with a one-tap revoke (kill CDP session) — matches UnifiedPush-style user-control expectations.

**Suggested stack, summarized:** native Compose + M3 Expressive (`MaterialExpressiveTheme`, `MotionScheme.expressive()`), edge-to-edge with per-component insets, `ListDetailPaneScaffold` adaptive, mikepenz markdown (streaming + `-code` highlighting) + Coil 3 + CameraX + platform speech, UnifiedPush-via-ntfy push with foreground-service + battery-exemption UX behind Cloudflare Tunnel (Access only on human UI), CDP-relay screencast for agent observation with Custom-Tab password handoff.

#!/usr/bin/env fish
# /rc backend: pin current session for OpenCode Mobile. Prints only the card.

set -l unit ~/.config/systemd/user/opencode-mobile.service
set -l user (grep OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME $unit | sed 's/.*USERNAME=//')
set -l pass (grep OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD $unit | sed 's/.*PASSWORD=//')
set -l base http://127.0.0.1:4096

set -l health (curl -sm5 -u "$user:$pass" $base/global/health)
if not string match -q '*"healthy":true*' "$health"
    systemctl --user start opencode-mobile.service
    sleep 2
    set health (curl -sm5 -u "$user:$pass" $base/global/health)

        echo "❌ serve down — could not start opencode-mobile.service"
        exit 1
    end
end

set -l cwd (pwd)
set -l projects (curl -sm5 -u "$user:$pass" "$base/project")
set -lx RC_CWD $cwd
set -l ws (echo $projects | python3 -c "
import json,sys,os
cwd=os.environ.get('RC_CWD','')
best=None
for p in json.load(sys.stdin):
    w=p.get('worktree') or ''

print((best[1]+' ('+best[0]+')') if best else cwd)
" 2>/dev/null)
set -l sessions (curl -sm5 -u "$user:$pass" "$base/session?directory=$cwd")

    echo "❌ no sessions served for $cwd"
    exit 1
end
set -l cur_title (echo $sessions | python3 -c "import json,sys; ss=json.load(sys.stdin); print([s for s in ss if s['id']=='$id'][0]['title'])")

set -l new_title "$cur_title"
if test (count $argv) -gt 0

else if not string match -q '📲*' "$cur_title"

    curl -sm5 -u "$user:$pass" -X PATCH "$base/session/$id" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"title\":$esc}" > /dev/null

echo "✅ **$new_title**"

## Gap/pitfall analysis (all fixed into the plan)

1. **Teardown target widened (R11).** The white-logo app is RN/Expo — good for UX flows, zero code reuse for Kotlin. Fix: teardown covers **two** repos — alvarolorentedev (UX + connection profiles + QR pairing) **and** grapeot's native Kotlin client (Retrofit interface, SSE reconnect, ViewModels — directly reusable patterns).
2. **Temp-mode "hide locally" accumulates server sessions.** Fix: added setting + action "purge hidden temp sessions" (manual + auto after N days); temp filter is per-server-list.
3. **"Projects" don't exist server-side.** opencode's Project = directory. Your Claude-like projects (memory/instructions per project) become a **client-side Room entity** mapping to dirs, injected via system prompt on send. Recorded as design decision D1.
4. **Websearch/memory/permission/browser toggles need server mappings.** Fix recorded: websearch toggle = per-message `tools` gating (include/exclude webfetch) · memory toggle = simple-memory context injection on/off · permission default = PATCH `/config` permission rules · browser backend switch = MCP enable/disable via `/mcp` + per-message tools gating. All flagged as spec-phase verification against live `/doc`.
5. **Attachment upload = highest risk, unchanged.** No `serve` upload endpoint; first implementation probe is live `/doc` + web-client upload path inspection before building H2.
6. **Full vim emulation = highest-effort UI item.** Fix: library-first search (no known mature Compose vim library — expect custom `InputConnection`), tracked as its own workstream, does not block chat.
7. **Extended widget (your choice, no versioning).** Fix: widget = Claude 3 buttons + recent-session shortcuts + connection status; status via WorkManager poll, battery cost documented. Phases reframed as **build order, not version cuts** — everything gets built, each phase smoke-tested vs grand plan.
8. **Three research docs were implicit, now explicit:** `ai-app-patterns.md` (ChatGPT/Gemini generic patterns — your "ai mobile app" item), `mobile-principles.md` (dev philosophy, good/bad practices), `app-optimization.md` (startup, baseline profiles, R8, list/render perf). Total now **13 research docs** + grand plan + AGENTS.md.
9. **Tailscale cutover.** `/rc` + Tailscale flow keeps working until Tunnel cutover; plan includes migration step + keeping `bin/rc` functional during transition. UI verification method recorded: emulator screenshots attached in-session per your "screenshot it" rule. Knowledge persistence: `mobile/.remember/` + memory entities, separate from this repo's own `.remember`.

Open design questions that need you at spec phase (not now): ntfy topic naming/auth, default permission allowlist, browser-switch exact mechanism after `/doc` probe, vim scope details, widget shortcut count. Nothing here blocks writing docs.

## To proceed

Switch this session to **build mode**, and I will write: 13 research docs (full depth from the 6 completed tracks, no compression), `mobile/docs/grand-plan.md` (with the F1–F8/S/C/H/B/P/T/X IDs, settings catalog, D1–D4 decisions, phase build order, cross-check list against your first message), and `mobile/AGENTS.md` (lean wiring). +# 01 — Claude mobile app UX autopsy
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. This doc is research input, not decisions.
+Researched 2026-10-03 from primary Anthropic sources (code.claude.com, support.claude.com, Play listing).
+
+## 1. App structure
+
+- Single "Claude" app (Play `com.anthropic.claude`, 50M+, 4.6). No separate Code app.
+- Bottom nav: chat home + **Code tab**. `claude.ai/code/new` starts a Code session.
+- Code tab → session list, `code` → Projects → New project.
+
+## 2. Session list
+
+- Sessions found by name at Code tab / `claude.ai/code`.
+- Remote Control sessions: computer icon + green online dot.
+- Title precedence: explicit `--name` → `/rename` → last meaningful message → auto `host-adjective-noun`.
+- Paid plans: RAG search over past chats (surfaced as tool calls, citations link back).
+  - Scope: all non-project chats together; inside a project only that project's chats.
+  - Incognito (ghost icon) excluded from search/memory.
+
+## 3. Chat + input bar
+
+- `+` menu: Add files/photos, Memory off-switch (must be set BEFORE first message, locked after).
+- Mic = dictation (speech→text, text reply). Sound-wave = full-duplex voice mode.
+- Model menu next to send: model + effort + thinking. Changeable anytime, applies from next response.
+- Effort: Low/Medium/High/xHigh (Opus long agentic)/Max. Thinking toggle with timer + expandable section.
+- Newer models force thinking on.
+
+## 4. Attachments pipeline
+
+- Types: PDF/DOCX/CSV/TXT/HTML/ODT/RTF/EPUB/JSON/XLSX (XLSX needs code exec). Images JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP.
+- Limits: 500MB/file, ≤20/chat, images ≤8000×8000, PDF ≤1000 pages (visual ≤100). Project files 30MB/file.
+- Remote Control from phone: photos → visible to Claude + saved `~/.claude/uploads/`;
+  other files → downloaded to host, passed as `@` refs; `@` autocompletes local project paths.
+- Undownloadable → `[n of m attachments did not arrive]` note, message still delivered.
+
+## 5. Voice
+
+- Dictation: all plans, 12 languages (EN/FR/DE/HI/IT/JA/KO/PT/RU/ES/TR/UK, non-EN beta).
+  Audio deleted after transcription, not used for training.
+- Voice mode (beta, phone-first): hands-free (pause-detect) vs push-to-talk, voice+pace picker,
+  model selector, mid-conversation code-switch, transcripts saved as text, connected tools usable.
+
+## 6. Background / push / widget
+
+- Phone never runs code. Cloud sessions survive phone close, persist across devices.
+- Remote Control drives own machine (must stay awake, `tmux`/`screen`; sleep → auto-reconnect).
+- Push triggers: Claude-initiated (task done, decision needed) or explicit ("notify me when…").
+  Two `/config` toggles: `Push when Claude decides`, `Push when actions required`.
+- Setup: same account/org, OS notify permission, open app once to refresh push token.
+- Skipped while typing/focused; `CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE` extends presence suppression.
+- Android battery optimization can delay push → app must guide exemption.
+- Widget (Android 8.0+, resizable): spark = new chat, camera = new chat + camera,
+  mic = new chat + dictation. All widget starts count toward usage.
+
+## 7. Permission prompts
+
+- Modes (dropdown by prompt box): cloud Accept-edits (default), Plan, Auto (org-gated).
+  Self-started Remote Control: Manual, Accept edits, Plan — no Auto, no Bypass from app.
+- Manual = approve edits/shell/network. acceptEdits = + file ops in scope.
+  Plan = research only until plan approved. Auto = classifier reviews, ask-rules still prompt.
+- Deny rules win everywhere. `rm` on critical paths, `AskUserQuestion`, org-`ask` connectors never auto-approved.
+- Permission prompts + `AskUserQuestion` stay open until answered in-thread.
+  Other dialogs expire after 5 min (`dialogExpiry`).
+- Mobile command limits: `/plugin`, `/resume`, `/claude-api` are local-only.
+  From app use arg-forms: `/model sonnet`, `/effort high`, `/compact`, `/context`, `/usage`, `/rename`, `/mcp`.
+
+## 8. Projects vs chats
+
+- Chats: single linear thread; optional incognito (unsaved) or memory-off (saved, unremembered).
+- Classic Projects: workspace with own chats + knowledge + instructions + per-project memory.
+  Paid RAG ~10× capacity. Search stays inside the project.
+- New Projects beta (Code-first): coordinator conversation + parallel worker threads
+  (own branch/PR each, auto-fix watching). Overview: Threads (Ready/Waiting/Working/Landing/Idle/Resolved),
+  Library, Pull requests, Routines. `Work locally` runs one thread via Remote Control.
+  Cap 200 new threads/day; idle costs nothing; Delete is permanent.
+- Mobile creation: Code tab → Projects → New project (Name required, Goal + Context optional).
+
+## 9. OS citizenship (why the bar is high)
+
+- Android intents/share/clock/calendar/maps/Health Connect with native charts.
+- Contextual least-privilege prompts with preview-before-send (Messages/Email need no perm via share+preview).
+- Per-topic memory with edit/delete, per-chat kill switch, incognito, never-save IDs.
+- Enterprise: SSO/SCIM, model allowlists, Trusted Devices (biometric/passkey step-up), audit logs.
+
+## 10. Takeaways for opencode remote
+
+- Copy: Code-tab session list with online dots, `+` attach menu, memory pre-first-message switch,
+  model+effort picker by send button, presence-aware push, resizable 3-button widget,
+  in-thread approvals that never silently expire, per-project memory scoping.
+- Beat: opencode sessions run on OUR hardware (no cloud), so push needs our own bridge;
+  permission model maps to opencode allow/ask/deny + remember — simpler, show it inline like Claude's cards.
+
+## Sources
+
+- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mobile
+- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/remote-control
+- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-projects
+- https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes

+- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11869629-use-claude-with-android-apps
+- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11101966-use-voice-mode
+- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065434-use-dictation-on-claude-mobile
+- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8241126-upload-files-to-claude
+- https://support.claude.com/en/articles/8664678-change-the-model-effort-and-thinking-settings

+# 02 — AI mobile app patterns (ChatGPT / Gemini / generic)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Research input, not decisions.
+Covers the "ai mobile app" brief item: what good AI apps share, beyond Claude specifics.
+
+## 1. Universal chat-app skeleton
+
+- Three-pane information architecture: sidebar/session drawer → thread → composer.
+  Mobile collapses to one pane with bottom-sheet drawer + back-stack navigation.
+- Session list rows: title + timestamp + status dot (idle/working/error). Search field pinned at top.
+- Composer anatomy (left→right): `+` attach → text field (multiline, grows to ~5 lines) →
+  mic → send/stop morphing button. Model/ratio chip above or beside send.
+- Streaming: tokens append in place; stop button replaces send while busy; auto-scroll
+  with "jump to latest" FAB when user scrolls up (see grapeot PRD: 60% of time is reading).
+
+## 2. Message rendering rules
+
+- Markdown first-class: headings, lists, tables, code fences with language header + copy button,
+  inline code chips, links as tappable spans. Render incrementally (streaming tail re-parse only).
+- Tool/activity cards: collapsible rows per tool call (pending → running → done/error),
+  expandable diff/patch views, todo checklists with live check-off.
+- Reasoning blocks: collapsed by default with timer ("thought for 12s"), expandable.
+- Cost/token footer per turn: small muted line (input/output/cached tokens + $) — matches H10 stats.
+- Error states render INLINE (model failure inside 200 response): red card with retry button,
+  never a toast-only failure.
+
+## 3. Sessions lifecycle patterns
+
+- New chat is instant (no modal); title backfills from first exchange. Explicit rename via long-press.
+- Fork/branch: long-press a message → "branch from here". Archive vs delete separated
+  (archive hides, delete destroys + confirms).
+- Cross-device continuity: server is source of truth; client reconciles on foreground
+  (status poll + message fetch). Optimistic send with rollback on failure.
+- Temporary/incognito: one toggle at creation; temp chats excluded from search/history/export.
+
+## 4. Input modalities
+
+- Dictation (speech→text into composer) vs voice mode (full duplex conversation) — offer both,
+  like Claude. Dictation is cheap (platform SpeechRecognizer); voice mode is a workstream.
+- Attach: photo picker (no storage perm), camera (CameraX), file picker (SAF, scoped).
+  Show staged attachments as chips above composer with remove ×; compress images by setting.
+- Slash commands: `/` in composer opens autocomplete sheet over keyboard; custom commands listed with descriptions.
+
+## 5. Notifications done right
+
+- Reply notifications: HIGH channel, direct-reply action + mark-read action.
+- Approval stalls: separate channel, approve/deny inline actions on the notification itself.
+- Quiet hours setting + per-session mute. Never badge the launcher for agent-typing noise.
+- Presence-awareness: suppress push for the session currently open on screen.
+
+## 6. Anti-patterns seen in wrapper apps
+
+- Fire-and-forget bubbles with no tool visibility (user can't see what agent did).
+- Blocking HTTP send with spinner (dies on radio drop; use async + SSE).
+- Hidden history / no export / no delete (trust killer).
+- Blanket permission grabs at install (storage+contacts for a chat app).
+- WebView-wrapped website shipped as "app" (no offline, no push, no widget, slow).
+- No empty states, no offline states, no retry affordance — just spinners.
+
+## 7. Takeaways for opencode remote
+
+- Skeleton: drawer list + thread + composer is non-negotiable; add agent/model chips (opencode-specific).
+- Inline tool cards + reasoning collapse + per-turn cost footer = the quality bar.
+- Async send + reconcile is the ONLY send path for long turns (matches S3/H1).
+- Temp mode, per-session mute, quiet hours all ship (F5 settings).

+# 03 — Third-party opencode clients (incl. R11 teardown targets)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Research input, not decisions.
+Researched 2026-10-03 via gh_grep + repo README/RFC fetches.
+
+## 1. OpenCode Mobile — alvarolorentedev (UX reference, inspiration only)
+
+- Repo: https://github.com/alvarolorentedev/opencode-mobile — Apache-2.0, 232★/25 forks
+- Site: https://getopencode.app/ — Play `app.getopencode` (white square logo — the app currently in use), TestFlight, direct APK
+- Stack: React Native + Expo (~57) + TS + Expo Router, react-native-paper,
+  `@opencode-ai/sdk` + `@opencode/client`, expo-secure-store, expo-notifications, Playwright web e2e.
+- Features: multi-server connection profiles; per-server sessions/model selection;
+  start/continue with agent+model picker; live progress view; permission approve/deny;
+  terminal; file browse + targeted patch; voice input; context/token/cost inspection;
+  push via Expo. Transport: HTTPS/tunnel to `opencode serve --port 4096`, phone holds no code.
+- Good: only client shipped to both stores; onboarding stresses authenticated HTTPS/tunnel;
+  connection-profile scoping is the model to copy; large node test suite incl. fake serve.
+- Bad: Expo (nothing reusable for Kotlin bg behavior); SDK pin lags `serve` breaks;
+  no in-app SSH tunnel; permission/voice internals JS-side, wire protocol undocumented.
+- R11 teardown: UX flows + onboarding copy + profile model. No code reuse (different stack).
+
+## 2. OpenCode Android Client — grapeot (native blueprint, patterns reusable)
+
+- Android: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client — MIT, 97★
+- iOS sibling: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_ios_client — MIT, 257★
+- Stack: Kotlin, Compose + M3, OkHttp + Retrofit, kotlinx.serialization, Hilt,
+  EncryptedSharedPreferences + Keystore, `network_security_config.xml`, planned SSH (mwiede/JSch).
+- Wire API (from `docs/RFC.md` — most useful single doc for this project):
+  `GET /global/health`, `GET /session`, `POST /session`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /session/{id}`,
+  `GET /session/status`, `GET /session/{id}/message`, `POST /session/{id}/prompt_async`,
+  `POST /session/{id}/abort`, `POST /session/{id}/fork`, permission + question endpoints,
+  `GET /config/providers`, `GET /agent`, `GET /session/{id}/diff`, `/todo`,
+  `GET /file`, `/file/content`, `/file/status`, `GET /find/file`.
+- SSE: single OkHttp EventSource → `/global/event`, `Flow<Result<SSEEvent>>`,
+  1s→30s exponential-backoff reconnect. Auth: Basic (`OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD`, user `opencode`).
+- Features: chat with Markdown/patch/todo/tool cards, streaming text+reasoning deltas, auto-follow;
+  files with git markers, image zoom/pan/share, Markdown WebView preview;
+  sessions rename/fork/archive; model shortlist + per-session model/agent memory + draft persistence;
+  voice via realtime WebSocket; tablet 3-pane; Host Profiles (Direct vs SSH, JSON import/export, TOFU keys).
+- Good: copy-pasteable Retrofit shape + SSE reconnect; cleartext policy
+  (localhost/`10.0.2.2`/`*.ts.net` allowlist, HTTPS otherwise); no-background-SSE discipline
+  (REST resync on foreground); PRD quantifies 60% Markdown reading → render quality over editor features.
+- Bad: docs bilingual CN/EN, partly aspirational (Web preview / SSH planned);
+  voice needs external AI Builder; no push/FGS notification (explicitly deferred);
+  no `/v1/` versioning → defensive-parse only.
+- R11 teardown: RFC.md + PRD.md + network layer + ViewModel states. Direct pattern reuse.
+
+## 3. Opencode Android — mulkymalikuldhrs (architecture diagrams only)
+
+- Repo: https://github.com/mulkymalikuldhrs/opencode-android — MIT, 28★
+- Claimed: Kotlin + Compose + M3, OkHttp SSE + WS + Retrofit, MVVM, Room/DataStore,
+  cert pinning / encrypted prefs (partial per own notes).
+- Claimed: SSE chat streaming, remote terminal, code editor, file manager,
+  multi-session + multi-server, dark theme, foldable split.
+- Verdict: template/scaffolding-grade, working SSE unverified; ports/docs inconsistent
+  (`:4096` vs `:8080`); no permission/question flow, no voice, thin tunnel story.
+- Use: thin-client layering diagrams (UI → SSE/WS/REST → TLS → server) only. Not a base.
+
+## 4. OpenCode Mobile Plugin — doza62 (push + pairing, not a chat client)
+
+- Repo: https://github.com/doza62/opencode-mobile — MIT, 291★/51 forks
+- Stack: TS opencode plugin, tunnel providers (Cloudflare/ngrok/localtunnel), Expo push,
+  `mobile-tokens.json`, CLI (`bin/install|qr|audit|uninstall`).
+- `/mobile` renders QR with tunnel URL; phone registers Expo push token; server events → push.
+- Good: solves secure exposure without port-forward + background notifications
+  (the gap grapeot defers). QR-pairing flow worth copying (our X4).
+- Bad: no chat/SSE/permissions; tunnel adds failure modes; pushes via Expo infra (we use ntfy instead).
+
+## 5. Paseo — getpaseo/paseo (daemon pattern reference)
+
+- Repo: https://github.com/getpaseo/paseo — Apache-2.0, 19.4k★
+- TS monorepo: `packages/server` daemon (WS API) + Expo client + Electron + CLI;
+  `packages/server/src/server/agent/providers/opencode/server-manager.ts` spawns/manages `serve` per runtime.
+- Good: device pairing (Settings → Pair Device), relay vs direct, voice mode, self-hosted posture.
+- Bad: daemon hop instead of direct `serve` HTTP+SSE; opencode flows abstracted away.
+- Use: pairing UX + bridge-process supervision ideas for our ntfy bridge. Not a base.
+
+## 6. Telegram bots (API-semantics reference)
+
+- grinev/opencode-telegram-bot (https://github.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot, MIT, 1.2k★,
+  Node 22 + grammY): `localhost:4096` (V1) / `127.0.0.1:49374` (V2, password).
+  Most complete permission/question/queue implementation: inline approve/deny,
+  model favorites+recent picker, revert/fork, scheduled tasks, queue vs steer,
+  Whisper voice, `/ls` browser. Read for STATE MACHINES before designing ViewModels.
+- ceociocto/opencode-remote-control: deprecated by author. Skip (cautionary example).
+
+## 7. Build-on summary
+
+- Wire protocol: grapeot Retrofit table + single `/global/event` OkHttp EventSource with backoff;
+  sends via `POST /session/{id}/prompt_async` (never block on sync POST for long turns).
+- Product scope: alvarolorentedev connection-profiles + permission/usage surfaces;
+  grapeot PRD steer-prioritization (Markdown render > voice > files).
+- Onboarding + background: doza62 QR/tunnel pairing + push approach (reimplemented on ntfy, no Expo).
+- Semantics: grinev bot for permission/question/queue/steer edge cases.
+- Avoid as base: mulkymalikuldhrs (unverified), Paseo hop (unless multi-agent needed later).

+# 04 — Mobile development principles & philosophy (good / bad practices)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Applies to all implementation phases.
+
+## 1. Guiding principles
+
+- Server is source of truth; phone is a smart cache. Every screen must survive process death
+  (ViewModel + SavedStateHandle + Room), because Android WILL kill the process.
+- Async-first: no blocking network on main thread, no synchronous send-then-spinner.
+  Every request has timeout + retry + visible state (sending/sent/failed-retry).
+- Offline is a state, not an error: cached sessions/threads render read-only with a banner;
+  queued sends flush on reconnect. Design empty/offline/error states before happy path.
+- Least privilege, most clarity: each permission requested with a sentence saying WHY;
+  aggressive onboarding (per user decision) lists all, but each row still explains itself.
+- Battery is a feature: no polling loops; SSE only while foreground (or bounded FGS);
+  WorkManager for deferred work; respect Doze instead of fighting it (see doc 05).
+
+## 2. Architecture hygiene (Android)
+
+- MVVM + UDF: `ViewModel` holds `StateFlow<UiState>`; Composables render, never fetch.
+- Layering: `:app` (wiring) → `:feature:*` (screens+VMs) → `:domain` (pure Kotlin use-cases, no Android imports)
+  → `:data` (Retrofit/Room/DataStore/WorkManager behind interfaces). KMP-extractable later.
+- Repository interfaces in `:domain`, implementations in `:data`. Push behind `PushGateway`
+  interface (UnifiedPush / FGS-fallback). Theme behind `ThemeRepository` (JSON tokens → M3 scheme).
+- One source of truth per datum: sessions list from one Flow; thread from one Flow;
+  never two caches of the same session diverging.
+- Dependency injection with Hilt; no service locators, no static singletons holding Context.
+
+## 3. Networking discipline (the S3 connection contract in code)
+
+- OkHttp single client: preemptive Basic auth + 401 Authenticator, TLS (no cleartext off-device),
+  `network_security_config.xml` allowlist (localhost/`10.0.2.2` only for dev).
+- `prompt_async` for sends (204, no long-lived HTTP). Sync `POST message` only for short turns w/ timeout.
+- SSE: one EventSource to `/event` (fallback `/global/event`), 1s→30s exp backoff + jitter,
+  `since=`/status-poll resync after reconnect. `?directory=` on every request.
+- Version pin: `GET /global/health` at connect; gate behavior per server version; defensive-parse
+  unknown event/part fields (log + skip, never crash).
+- Structured concurrency: `viewModelScope` + `SupervisorJob`; cancel streams on `onCleared`;
+  no `GlobalScope`, no leaked callbacks.
+
+## 4. Compose rules
+
+- State hoisting: screens stateless, state lives in VM. `collectAsStateWithLifecycle()`.
+- Lazy lists with stable keys; `key(session.id)` everywhere; avoid re-composition storms
+  during streaming (buffer deltas ~100–200ms before recompose of markdown tail).
+- Streaming markdown: `rememberStreamingMarkdownState` + append; re-parse tail only.
+- Insets per-component (`imePadding`, `navigationBarsPadding`, `statusBarsPadding`);
+  never root-level `safeDrawingPadding`. IME-animated composer (see doc 08).
+- Test at 200% font scale + German-length strings; no hardcoded dp heights on text containers.
+
+## 5. Good practices checklist
+
+- Baseline Profiles + R8 + App Bundle from P0; measure startup (TTID) on an API-26 device.
+- EncryptedSharedPreferences + Keystore for passwords/tokens; `FLAG_SECURE` on sensitive surfaces;
+  no secrets in logs, no PII in crash reports.
+- Notification channels from day one (HIGH replies, LOW status); never reuse/delete channels.
+- Feature flags / settings for every behavior (F5 catalog, doc 13) — but flags need owners + defaults.
+- Tests: ViewModel + repository unit tests; fake `serve` (see alvarolorentedev `tests/*.test.mjs` pattern,
+  port to MockWebServer); screenshot tests for theme tokens; manual Doze/OEM matrix (doc 05 §6).
+
+## 6. Bad practices (banned)
+
+- Blocking REST for agent turns; perpetual background SSE; polling the server on a timer.
+- `GlobalScope`, static Context, leaking EventSources across config changes.
+- Hardcoded colors/sp/dp (all through theme tokens, doc 08/13).
+- Blind `PATCH /config` (GET-then-merge only); blind schema assumptions (defensive parse).
+- WebView-wrapped site as "app"; Expo-style JS push infra (we are on-prem, doc 09).
+- Compressing plans, skipping verification, drifting from grand-plan (project rule, not just code).

+# 05 — Android constraints 2025–2026 (background, battery, insets, minSdk)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Verified 2026-10-03 against official Android docs.
+Re-verify Play target-SDK deadline + FGS-notification-without-grant rendering at build time.
+
+## 1. Headline: no perpetual background SSE
+
+Five releases made indefinite background sockets impractical: bg FGS-start bans (12+),
+mandatory FGS types (14+), `dataSync` 6h/24h cap (15+), job quotas alongside FGS (16),
+Doze deferral, OEM killers. Supported architecture: **push-to-wake + short-lived connections**
+(open SSE only while chat UI foreground or bounded sync). Our push = ntfy bridge (doc 09).
+
+## 2. Foreground service types (mandatory API 34+)
+
+- Every FGS declares `android:foregroundServiceType` + holds `FOREGROUND_SERVICE` + type permission.
+- `dataSync`: uploads/downloads/fetch — closest fit for agent sync, subject to 6h cap.
+- `remoteMessaging`: device-to-device SMS-style relay ONLY — claiming it for agent SSE risks Play rejection.
+- `specialUse`: needs manifest justification + Play Console declaration + human review.
+- `shortService` (34+): ~3-min timeout, no sticky — "finish send after backgrounding" only.
+- What we use: `dataSync` FGS started from visible activity for live SSE while chatting;
+  stop on backgrounding. UIDT jobs (34+, `RUN_USER_INITIATED_JOBS`) for attachment uploads;
+  FGS-worker fallback below 34.
+- Background start ban (31+): no `startForegroundService()` from background
+  (`ForegroundServiceStartNotAllowedException`). Exemptions: high-priority FCM (n/a — no Firebase),
+  user tap on notification/widget, battery-optimizations-off, visible overlay.
+- Boot (targetSdk 35+): boot receiver CANNOT launch `dataSync`/camera/mic FGS — schedule WorkManager instead.
+- `dataSync` 6h/24h cap: overrun → `onTimeout()` then crash if not stopped in seconds;
+  exhausted quota at start → start exception. Honor via timeout + WorkManager handoff.
+- Android 16: jobs running concurrently with an FGS count against JobScheduler quota.
+  Monitor `WorkInfo.getStopReason()` / `JobParameters.getStopReason()`.
+
+## 3. Doze / App Standby / battery exemption
+
+- Doze (screen off, stationary, unplugged): network suspended, jobs/alarms deferred to
+  shrinking maintenance windows. App Standby: untouched apps → network ~1×/day until charger.
+- Official line: use push infra (FCM in docs; ntfy+UnifiedPush in our case), not own socket.
+- Exemption flow: `PowerManager.isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations()` → settings intent
+  (`ACTION_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_SETTINGS`) preferred; direct request
+  (`ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS`) is Play-restricted for chat apps —
+  USER CHOSE fully-aggressive anyway: we do the direct request, accept Play-review risk,
+  sideload first / Play later. Recorded as decision D5.
+- OEM killers (dontkillmyapp.com, re-verified 2026-06), worst→least:
+  Huawei > Xiaomi > OnePlus > Samsung > rest; Pixel ≈ stock.
+  - Samsung: sleeping/deep-sleeping lists + auto re-sleep (~3 days); needs Don't-optimize + Recents lock.
+    One UI 6.0+: FGS of API-34-targeted apps "work as intended".
+  - Xiaomi/MIUI: Autostart permission + Battery saver → No restrictions + Recents pin required by default.
+    Detect autostart state via community MIUI-autostart API.
+- Budget: in-app "background health" screen (P4) — exemption status, OEM deep-link instructions,
+  ntfy registration diagnostics. No code path survives Xiaomi/Samsung defaults without user action.
+
+## 4. Notifications
+
+- `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` runtime permission since API 33 — request in aggressive onboarding with rationale.
+- Channels (API 26+): create BEFORE posting; importance user-overridable → choose deliberately:
+  agent-reply HIGH, approval-stall HIGH (separate channel), FGS-status LOW/MIN, no sound.
+  Never delete/recreate channels (resets user prefs).
+- FGS still needs a `Notification` object regardless of grant — honest "connection live" indicator.
+- API 34+: full-screen intent needs `USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT` + user grant (reserve for calls, not messages).
+  Don't rely on exact alarms for keepalive (`SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM` is user-granted).
+
+## 5. Edge-to-edge (forced on targetSdk 35+ / Android 15)
+
+- Status/nav transparent, offsets disabled; `setStatusBarColor`/`setDecorFitsSystemWindows` deprecated.
+- Cutout modes coerced to ALWAYS — pad around `WindowInsets.displayCutout` yourself.
+- Implementation: `enableEdgeToEdge()` + per-component insets (Views: `ViewCompat` listener;
+  Compose: `statusBars`/`navigationBars`/`displayCutout`/`ime` insets, Scaffold `contentWindowInsets`).
+- Material3 Compose handles insets mostly automatically; Material2 does NOT.
+- Chat-critical: composer padding driven by ANIMATED IME inset, not `adjustResize` alone;
+  test gesture nav + 3-button nav + cutout/foldable images. Audit onboarding/settings screens too.
+
+## 6. minSdk / targetSdk — LOCKED: minSdk 26, targetSdk current
+
+- minSdk 26 (Android 8.0, 2017): channels native, Autofill, adaptive icons, ShortcutManager,
+  uniform background-limits baseline. Drops ~7.x (small, shrinking — confirm in Play Console stats).
+- Desugaring (`coreLibraryDesugaringEnabled`) backports `java.time`/streams/concurrent to the 20s —
+  language APIs are NOT a reason to raise minSdk; only framework behaviors are.
+- Compose + M3 + Room + WorkManager + DataStore all support 21+ — no constraint from minSdk 26.
+- targetSdk/compileSdk track current Play requirement independently (35 required Aug 2025;
+  36 enforcement on August cadence — verify at build time).
+- Device lab for P6 hardening: physical or imaged API 26 (channels/FGS-old), API 33 (notif perm),
+  API 35 (edge-to-edge forced), Samsung + Xiaomi skins, foldable.
+

+# 06 — Stack decision (LOCKED: native Kotlin)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Decision locked 2026-10-04 with user. Revisit only with user approval.
+
+## Decision
+
+**100% native Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Material3 Expressive**, OkHttp SSE,
+Room, DataStore, WorkManager, Hilt, kotlinx.serialization, Coil 3, CameraX.
+minSdk 26, targetSdk/compileSdk current. Modules `:app / :feature:* / :domain / :data`.
+
+Only (A)/(B) give full Android-framework access for our hardest constraints
+(old devices + background SSE + self-hosted push + WebRTC/VNC). iOS is future/possible,
+so cross-platform UI buys nothing now and costs quality daily.
+
+## Comparison (researched 2026-10-03, relative rankings, no invented benchmarks)
+
+| Criterion | (A) Native Kotlin ✅ | (B) KMP shared | (C) Flutter | (D) RN/Expo |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| Old-Android compat | Best (Compose minSdk 21+) | Same on Android | Plugin-gated (e.g. webrtc→23) | Worst (RN 0.73+ → 23–24) |
+| Background services | Full FGS/WorkManager/Doze control | Same Android, zero iOS share | Isolates plumbing, second-class | Deprecated bg-fetch → bg-task, weakest |
+| Startup | Fastest (baseline profiles, R8) | Same | Engine-init cost | Slowest (Hermes helps, still bundle parse) |
+| APK size | Smallest (R8, bundles, ABI splits) | Slightly larger | Largest (libflutter.so per ABI) | Mid-large |
+| Chat/SSE/markdown | OkHttp EventSource + streaming markdown, full control | Transport shared, UI per-platform anyway | Streaming jank + highlight gaps | Polyfill SSE, thinnest VNC |
+| VNC + WebRTC | Google WebRTC SDK + JVM VNC, direct interop | Same Android, doubled iOS work | flutter-webrtc 701 open issues, VNC DIY | Community only, heavy bridging |
+| Offline | Reference path (Room+DataStore+WM) | Feasible (KMP samples) | Two failure domains | Weakest scheduling |
+| Theming | M3 dynamic color, CompositionLocal tokens | Same Android, iOS separate anyway | M3 fidelity lags | Native views escape system |
+| No-Firebase push | Best UnifiedPush host (Tusky/Element/Nextcloud Talk pattern) | Same Android | Needs native bridge | Same + worse scheduling |
+| Staffing | Any Android hire productive | Needs Kotlin+Swift senior | Easy Dart hire, escapes need Kotlin anyway | Largest pool, heaviest churn |
+
+- (B) only if iOS committed within ~12mo WITH iOS capacity. Otherwise dual-platform build/DI cost, zero shipped benefit.
+- (C)/(D) rejected: lose exactly where requirements are hardest.
+
+## Keep-the-door-open structure
+
+- `:domain` pure Kotlin, no Android imports; DTOs kotlinx.serialization from day one → drop into `commonMain` later.
+- `PushGateway` interface (UnifiedPush / FGS-fallback); theme behind `ThemeRepository`.
+- KMP status note: shared-logic KMP production-stable; Compose Multiplatform stable Android+iOS, web Beta —
+  stable ≠ cheap to staff. Revisit when iOS is real.
+
+## Key libraries (initial pin, verify at scaffold)
+
+- UI: `androidx.compose.material3:material3` (Expressive), `material3-adaptive` (ListDetailPaneScaffold),
+  `androidx.window` (foldables), `androidx.activity` (enableEdgeToEdge), `androidx.browser` (Custom Tabs)
+- Chat: mikepenz `multiplatform-markdown-renderer` (`-m3` + `-code` + `-coil3`), Coil 3, CameraX,
+  platform SpeechRecognizer, Media3 for voice playback, `LocalHapticFeedback`
+- Net/persist: OkHttp (+SSE), Retrofit, kotlinx.serialization, Room, DataStore, WorkManager, Hilt
+- Push: UnifiedPush `android-connector` (+ ntfy distributor app), CredentialManager (passkeys/autofill)
+- CDP: OkHttp WebSocket + kotlinx.serialization; optional kklisura/chrome-devtools-java-client
+- Widget: Glance (preferred) or RemoteViews; CameraX + Photo Picker (no storage perm)
+

+++ opencode/mobile/docs/07-serve-api-contract.md	
@@ -0,0 +1,162 @@
+# 07 — opencode `serve` API contract (mobile client mapping)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Verify EVERY endpoint against the LIVE `/doc`
+of the exact server version at implementation time. Known drift already exists.
+
+## 0. Transport
+
+- Base `{BASE}`: Tunnel TLS URL (prod) or `http://127.0.0.1:4096` (dev).
+  `serve` is plain HTTP (`--port` default 4096, `--hostname` default 127.0.0.1); TLS ends at Cloudflare.
+- Spec: `GET {BASE}/doc` = OpenAPI 3.1. Generate/verify client against live `/doc`; never hardcode schemas.
+- Auth: HTTP Basic on EVERY request when `OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD` set
+  (user `opencode` default, `OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME` override).
+  OkHttp: preemptive `Authorization: Basic base64(user:pass)` + 401 `Authenticator`. Never off-device plain HTTP.
+- `?directory=` on ~all endpoints routes multi-project servers — ALWAYS send project worktree.
+- Boot pin: `GET /global/health → {healthy, version}`; gate behavior per version.
+- Concurrency: ONE `serve` per machine (shared sqlite WAL) — client connects only, never spawns.
+
+## 1. Endpoint tables
+
+### Global / health / events
+
+| Method | URL | Mobile use |
+|---|---|---|
+| GET | `/global/health` | Boot check + version pin |
+| GET | `/event` (SSE) | PRIMARY stream (`server.connected` then `Event`s) |
+| GET | `/global/event` (SSE) | Legacy duplicate; prefer `/event`, support both |
+
+### Project / path
+
+| Method | URL | Mobile use |
+|---|---|---|
+| GET | `/project?directory=` | Workspace picker |
+| GET | `/project/current?directory=` | Current cwd context |
+| GET | `/path` | Show cwd |
+| GET | `/vcs` | Branch chip |
+
+### Sessions
+
+| Method | Body | Resp | Notes |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| GET `/session?directory=` | — | `Session[]` | List |
+| POST `/session?directory=` | `{parentID?, title?}` | `Session` | Create |
+| GET `/session/status` | — | `{[id]: idle\|busy\|retry}` | Poll fallback when SSE drops |
+| GET `/session/{id}` | — | `Session` | Details |
+| DELETE `/session/{id}` | — | bool | Delete + data |
+| PATCH `/session/{id}` | `{title?}` | `Session` | Rename |
+| GET `/session/{id}/children` | — | `Session[]` | Fork tree |
+| GET `/session/{id}/todo` | — | `Todo[]` | Agent todos |
+| POST `/session/{id}/init` | `{messageID, providerID, modelID}` | bool | → AGENTS.md |
+| POST `/session/{id}/fork` | `{messageID?}` | `Session` | Branch at message |
+| POST `/session/{id}/abort` | — | bool | Stop turn (`MessageAbortedError` may surface) |
+| POST `/session/{id}/share` | — | `Session` w/ `share.url` (opncd.ai) | PUBLIC — explicit confirm + unshare affordance |
+| DELETE `/session/{id}/share` | — | `Session` | Unshare |
+| GET `/session/{id}/diff?messageID=` | — | `FileDiff[]` | Review changes |
+| POST `/session/{id}/summarize` | `{providerID, modelID}` | bool | Summarize |
+| POST `/session/{id}/revert` | `{messageID, partID?}` | ⚠️ `Session` (types.gen) vs `boolean` (docs) — check live `/doc` | Undo |
+| POST `/session/{id}/unrevert` | — | ⚠️ same mismatch | Restore |
+| POST `/session/{id}/permissions/{permID}` | `{response: once\|always\|reject}` | bool — types.gen has ONLY `response`; docs claim extra `remember?` — send `response` only on v1 | Approval reply |
+
+`Session`: `id, projectID, directory, parentID?, summary?, share?, title, version, time{created,updated}, revert?`.
+
+### Messages (core: async send + SSE render)
+
+| Method | Body | Resp |
+|---|---|---|
+| GET `/session/{id}/message?limit=` | — | `{info: Message, parts: Part[]}[]` |
+| GET `/session/{id}/message/{msgID}` | — | `{info, parts}` |
+| POST `/session/{id}/message` | `{messageID?, model?{providerID,modelID}, agent?, noReply?, system?, tools?, parts}` | `{info, parts}` — BLOCKS full turn |
+| POST `/session/{id}/prompt_async` | same | 204 — result via SSE ✅ mobile send path |
+| POST `/session/{id}/command` | `{messageID?, agent?, model?: string, command, arguments}` — `model` is plain string here | `{info, parts}` |
+| POST `/session/{id}/shell` | `{agent, model?, command}` | `AssistantMessage` |
+
+Rule: sends via `prompt_async`; render `session.status` + `message.part.updated` deltas;
+`GET message` to reconcile; `session.idle` → confirm via detail GET.
+`noReply:true` injects context without triggering the model.
+
+### Part model
+
+- Sendable inputs: `text {text}`, `file {mime, filename?, url, source?}`,
+  `agent {name}`, `subtask {prompt, description, agent}`. No reasoning/tool inputs.
+- Renderable outputs: `text`, `reasoning`, `file`, `tool {callID, tool, state: pending|running|completed|error}`,
+  `step-start`, `step-finish {reason, cost, tokens}`, `snapshot`, `patch {hash, files}`,
+  `agent`, `retry {attempt, error}`, `compaction`, `subtask`.
+- Streaming: `message.part.updated {part, delta?}` — APPEND `delta` to text/reasoning/tool state.
+- Assistant `Message` carries `tokens{input,output,reasoning,cache}`, `cost`, `finish?`, `error?`
+  (`ProviderAuthError|UnknownError|MessageOutputLengthError|MessageAbortedError|APIError`) —
+  model failures arrive INSIDE 200 responses, not HTTP errors. Render inline with retry.
+
+### SSE catalog (`/event`)
+
+`server.connected`, `message.updated`, `message.part.updated`, `message.part.removed`, `message.removed`,
+`permission.updated (Permission)`, `permission.replied`, `session.status`, `session.idle`,
+`session.compacted`, `session.created|updated|deleted|diff|error`, `todo.updated`,
+`command.executed`, `file.edited`, `file.watcher.updated`, `vcs.branch.updated`,
+`tui.*`, `pty.*`, `lsp.*`, `installation.*`. Full union in types.gen `Event`.
+
+### Permissions flow
+
+1. SSE `permission.updated` → `Permission {id, type, pattern?, sessionID, messageID, callID?, title, metadata}`.
+2. Card: title/type/pattern; buttons Once / Always / Reject.
+3. `POST …/permissions/{id} {response}` → true; `permission.replied` confirms.
+4. Types: `edit, bash, webfetch, doom_loop, external_directory, read, glob, grep, task, skill, …`
+   → allow/ask/deny. Server `--auto` bypasses asks (denys enforced) — surface server mode in UI.
+
+### Providers / agents / commands
+
+| Method | Mobile use |
+|---|---|
+| GET `/provider` | Rich model picker (`all[].models` + limits/modalities/cost, `default`, `connected`) |
+| GET `/config/providers` | Lighter picker |
+| GET `/provider/auth` | Auth state |
+| POST `/provider/{id}/oauth/authorize` → `{url, method, instructions}` | OAuth start (browser handoff; awkward on mobile — flag) |
+| POST `/provider/{id}/oauth/callback` | OAuth finish |
+| PUT `/auth/{id}` | API-key auth path (preferred on mobile) |
+| GET `/agent` | Agent picker (plan/ask/build + custom) |
+| GET `/command` | `Command[] {name, description?, agent?, model?, template, subtask?}` → execute via `POST …/command` |
+
+### Files
+
+| Method | Resp |
+|---|---|
+| GET `/find?pattern=` | matches `{path, lines, line_number, absolute_offset, submatches}[]` |
+| GET `/find/file?query=&type=&directory=&limit=` | `string[]` |
+| GET `/find/symbol?query=` | `Symbol[]` |
+| GET `/file?path=` | `FileNode[]` |
+| GET `/file/content?path=` | `FileContent {type: text\|binary, content, diff?, patch?, encoding?: base64, mimeType?}` |
+| GET `/file/status` | `File[] {path, added, removed, status}` |
+
+### Config / misc
+
+- `GET /config`, `PATCH /config` (GET-then-merge, never blind overwrite).
+- `GET /experimental/tool/ids`, `GET /experimental/tool?provider=&model=`;
+  `GET /lsp|/formatter|/mcp`, `POST /mcp`; `POST /log`; `GET /doc`.
+- Skip: `POST /instance/dispose` (kills server), `/tui/*` (desktop TUI),
+  undocumented `/pty/*`, `/tui/publish`, `/tui/control/*`.
+
+## 2. Gaps / risks
+
+1. **Attachment upload UNDEFINED (highest mobile risk).** `FilePartInput` needs `url`;
+   no multipart/`POST /file` endpoint exists. `url` = server path? `file://`? `data:`? pre-staged?
+   → First implementation probe: live `/doc` + web-client upload path. H2 blocked on this answer.
+2. **No SSE resumption.** No Last-Event-ID/cursor/replay → resync via `/session/status` + `GET message?limit=`
+   (`limit` is the only paging; large sessions may truncate).
+3. **Schema drift v1 vs v2-fork.** revert/unrevert type, permission `remember?`, structured-output `format`
+   already diverge → verify each against live `/doc`, gate on `/global/health` version, defensive-parse.
+4. **Sync POST hangs.** Long-turn blocking call — mobile treats sync as optional/short-turn only.
+5. **OAuth on device.** Browser-redirect-to-server flow → prefer API-key `PUT /auth/{id}`; deep-link plan B.
+6. **Share = public** (opncd.ai) — confirm dialog + unshare required.
+7. **`?directory=` omission** silently targets wrong cwd — always send.
+
+## 3. Minimal flows
+
+- Boot: health → `/project` → `/provider` + `/agent` + `/command` → open `/event` SSE.
+- Chat: create/pick session → `GET message?limit=` → `prompt_async` → render deltas → `session.idle` → confirm GET.
+- Approval: `permission.updated` → card → `POST …/permissions/{id}`.
+- Interrupt/undo/branch/publish: abort / revert / fork / share (+unshare).
+
+## Sources
+
+- https://opencode.ai/docs/server/ · https://opencode.ai/docs/sdk/
+- https://opencode.ai/docs/permissions/ · https://opencode.ai/docs/share/ · https://opencode.ai/docs/commands/
+- https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/sdk/js/src/gen/types.gen.ts

+# 08 — UI/UX, theming engine, layout, scalability
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Theme tokens below are the DEFAULT scheme (dark cyberpunk neon);
+the engine (T1–T3) must allow full user restyling later.
+
+## 1. Material3 Expressive (locked UI framework)
+
+- `androidx.compose.material3:material3` (Expressive APIs; 1.4.0-alpha11 → 1.5.0-alphaX track).
+- Theme entry: `MaterialExpressiveTheme(colorScheme, motionScheme, shapes, typography, content)`;
+  `motionScheme = MotionScheme.expressive()` (or `.standard()`); custom components animate with
+  `MaterialTheme.motionScheme.defaultSpatialSpec()/defaultEffectsSpec()`.
+- New components to use: `ButtonGroup`, `LoadingIndicator` (for `PullToRefreshBox`),
+  expressive shape morphing, spring motion. Dynamic color stays (`dynamicDarkColorScheme/…`).
+- Catalogs: meticha/material-3-expressive-catalog, emertozd/compose-material-3-expressive-catalog.
+
+## 2. Default theme: dark cyberpunk neon (dark default; light + auto also ship)
+
+```
+background #05010F | surface #0B0620 | surfaceContainer* ramp on deep violet
+primary #00F0FF (cyan neon) | secondary #B537F2 (magenta) | tertiary #39FF14 (acid green, sparing)
+error #FF2A6D | onPrimary/onSurface ≥ 4.5:1 (neon-on-black passes, neon-on-neon doesn't)
+```
+
+- Neon glow without custom draw: `Modifier.shadow(elevation, spotColor = primary)` + graphicsLayer
+  on expressive springs; `drawBehind` bloom for send button only.
+- Expressive Shapes: large rounded 28dp+ bubbles → cyberpunk-soft look.
+- Light scheme: same hue family, lifted surfaces (define explicitly, never auto-invert).
+
+## 3. Theme engine (T1–T3: day-one architecture)
+
+- All color/type/shape/size values flow from `ThemeRepository` → `CompositionLocal` tokens → M3 scheme.
+  NO hardcoded colors/sp/dp in features (lint-enforced).
+- Token categories: colors (full M3 ramp + custom neon accents), typography (font family files + scale),
+  shapes (corner radii), sizes (bubble padding, composer height, icon sizes), effects (glow on/off, spring stiffness).
+- Dark / light / system-auto modes; scheme export/import JSON (user schemes later, X-scope);
+  screenshot tests per scheme × mode.
+- Dynamic knobs in settings (doc 13 §Theme): scheme, mode, font family, font size scale, glow intensity.
+
+## 4. Edge-to-edge + insets (forced posture, doc 05 §5)
+
+- `enableEdgeToEdge()` in `Activity.onCreate()`; per-component insets only:
+  `windowInsetsPadding(safeDrawing)` per screen, `imePadding()` on composer,
+  `navigationBarsPadding()` on bottom bars, `statusBarsPadding()` on top bars.
+- Message list draws behind nav bar (transparent); composer rides ABOVE IME via animated IME inset.
+- 3-button nav gets automatic translucent scrim; gesture nav fully transparent.
+- Audit low-traffic screens (onboarding, settings, rationales) — commonly occluded.
+
+## 5. Adaptive layouts (phones / foldables / tablets)
+
+- `material3-adaptive`: `ListDetailPaneScaffold` (sessions → thread — canonical chat pattern),
+  `NavigableListDetailPaneScaffold`; drive with `currentWindowAdaptiveInfo()` / `WindowSizeClass`.
+- Foldables: `androidx.window WindowInfoTracker` for hinge; never place composer under hinge.
+- Phone portrait: single pane + drawer; landscape/tablet: list+detail two-pane; large tablet: optional third
+  pane (files/diff). State preserved across form-factor changes.
+
+## 6. Dynamic type + i18n-proofing
+
+- `sp` follows system scale automatically; test at 200%. No hardcoded dp heights on text containers;
+  `Modifier.heightIn(min=)` + flexible layouts. Never cap `fontScale`.
+- Bubble widths verified with longest-locale strings at max scale.
+
+## 7. Chat-screen component map
+
+- TopAppBar: session title (tap → rename), status dot, model+effort chip, agent chip, overflow menu.
+- MessageList: date/session dividers; user bubbles right, agent left; tool cards collapsible;
+  reasoning collapsed + timer; patch/diff expandable; todo live check-off; per-turn cost footer;
+  error cards inline with retry; "jump to latest" FAB; pull-to-refresh → status-poll resync.
+- Composer: `+` attach (file/photo/camera) → growing text field (vim motions H13, `/` commands H12,
+  `@` path autocomplete) → mic → send/stop morph. Staged attachments as chips with ×.
+  Memory toggle + websearch indicator + browser chip as above-composer status row.
+- Permission cards: inline in thread at the requesting turn (Once / Always / Reject) + mirrored
+  in notification (P1) + background-health pending list.
+
+## 8. Motion + haptics
+
+- Expressive springs for send/appear; `Confirm` haptic on send, `Reject` on error, `LongPress` on actions.
+- Streaming: buffer deltas ~100–200ms before markdown-tail recompose (perf, doc 12).
+
+## Sources
+
+- https://m3.material.io/blog/m3-expressive-motion-theming
+- https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/system/setup-e2e
+- https://developer.android.com/develop/ui/compose/build-adaptive-apps

--- opencode/mobile/docs/09-push-without-firebase.md

@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+# 09 — Push without Firebase (ntfy + UnifiedPush + bridge)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. No Firebase, no paid services — on-prem only.
+Topology: `ntfy.uchabokeria.space` (doc: grand-plan §Topology).
+
+## 1. Why a bridge is required
+
+Android cannot hold a perpetual background SSE (doc 05): Doze, 6h `dataSync` cap,
+OEM killers. When the app is dead, SOMETHING server-side must observe `serve` and wake the phone.
+That something = tiny self-hosted bridge on blackwall: watches `serve /event` SSE,
+publishes to self-hosted ntfy topics. Phone subscribes via UnifiedPush (ntfy distributor).
+
+## 2. Components
+
+- **ntfy server** (self-hosted, Go, single binary): topics over HTTPS;
+  `GET /topic/json` (NDJSON + `since=` replay — use this), `/topic/sse`, `/topic/ws`;
+  priorities, auth, attachments, keepalive events. https://docs.ntfy.sh · https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy
+- **Bridge** (`serve → ntfy`, custom, runs on blackwall next to `serve`):
+  opens `GET /event` SSE with Basic auth; on `message.part.updated` (reply done → `session.idle`),
+  `permission.updated` (approval stall), `session.error` → POST to ntfy topic with priority +
+  minimal payload (session id + title + snippet; never secrets).
+  Supervised (systemd unit, auto-restart = "resurrection" on server side); backoff reconnect;
+  dedupe by event id; `since=` gap backfill on its own reconnect.
+- **App (UnifiedPush)**: embed `android-connector`; user picks distributor (ntfy app / Sunup / NextPush).
+  https://unifiedpush.org · https://github.com/UnifiedPush/android-connector
+- **Fallback (no distributor installed)**: foreground `dataSync` service holding ntfy SSE/WS
+  directly + battery-exemption UX (Gotify android pattern); degraded, documented as such.
+
+## 3. Topic + auth design (OPEN — spec phase with user)
+
+- One topic per user-device or per server? Proposal: `opencode-<user>-<device>` unguessable names
+  (random suffix), ntfy-native auth (Basic/token) stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences.
+- Machine endpoints stay OFF Cloudflare Access (Access breaks machine clients);
+  protected by ntfy auth + unguessable topics. Access only on human web UI, if ever.
+- Payloads: session id, event type, short snippet. Full content pulled via `serve` API on tap
+  (payload minimization = privacy + Doze-friendly small pushes).
+
+## 4. Notification mapping (app side)
+
+- Reply done → HIGH channel, actions: Open / Direct-reply / Mark-read. Presence-aware:
+  suppress for session currently open on screen.
+- Approval stall (`permission.updated`, `AskUserQuestion`) → separate HIGH channel,
+  inline Approve / Deny actions on the notification itself.
+- Bridge/error events → LOW channel (status), no sound.
+- Quiet hours + per-session mute (settings) applied client-side before posting.
+
+## 5. Cloudflare Tunnel notes
+
+- `cloudflared` outbound-only; no inbound ports. WebSockets fully supported through tunnels.
+- Prefer `/json` (NDJSON) or `/ws` endpoints with keepalives + client backoff over bare SSE
+  through proxies (idle timeouts). Use ntfy keepalive events as connection-health signal.
+- Cache + replay server-side (`since=<last-id>`) so Doze gaps backfill.
+
+## 6. What we do NOT use
+
+- FCM (Google dependency — banned by brief). Expo push (third-party cloud — banned).
+- `remoteMessaging` FGS type for this (Play-policy risk, doc 05).
+
+## Sources
+
+- https://unifiedpush.org · https://unifiedpush.org/developers/spec/android/
+- https://github.com/UnifiedPush/android-connector
+- https://github.com/binwiederhier/ntfy · https://docs.ntfy.sh/subscribe/api/ · https://docs.ntfy.sh/install/
+- https://github.com/gotify/server · https://github.com/gotify/android (FGS + exemption pattern)
+- https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/networks/connectors/cloudflare-tunnel/

+# 10 — In-app browser (CDP relay + password handoff)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Covers B1–B4.
+
+## 1. Decision: CDP relay (recommended), WebView for pages, no VNC
+
+| Approach | Verdict |
+|---|---|
+| **CDP relay** | ✅ Observe + drive the EXISTING agent Chrome (box `--remote-debugging-port` via Tunnel; app WebSocket → `/json`, speaks CDP: `Page.startScreencast` observe, `Input.dispatch*` control, `Runtime.evaluate` queries). Mirrors existing CDP-bridge architecture (`bin/bridge.ts`, `bin/cdp-mcp.ts`). Transport: OkHttp WS + kotlinx.serialization; optional kklisura/chrome-devtools-java-client. |
+| **WebView** (`androidx.webkit`, KevinnZou/compose-webview) | ✅ For rendering pages INSIDE the app (login pages, snapshots). Full DOM control. Cannot attach to external Chrome. |
+| **VNC** (noVNC-in-WebView) | ❌ Full-desktop encode, no DOM semantics, painful input. Only if agent box were VNC-only — it isn't. |
+
+## 2. B1 — Browser enable per chat
+
+- Per-session toggle "browser enabled" (default per settings). When on, browser MCP tools stay
+  in the message `tools` set; when off, excluded (same gating mechanism as H3 websearch).
+- Which backend (B2): setting `browser.backend = playwright | chrome-extension`.
+  Switch = MCP enable/disable via `POST /mcp` + per-message tools gating (verify against live `/doc` in spec phase).
+
+## 3. B3 — In-app screencast observe/control
+
+- Screen: screencast frames (throttled quality per settings) + status (URL, title) + control toggle.
+- Observe mode default; control mode requires explicit tap (and shows "YOU control" banner).
+- One-tap "return control to agent" + "kill CDP session" (revoke).
+- `FLAG_SECURE` on the observation surface (no screenshots by other apps).
+
+## 4. B4 — Password-entry handoff (concrete pattern)
+
+1. Detect password field: CDP `DOM.describeNode` / focus on `input[type=password]`, or WebView URL heuristic.
+2. Pause agent input; bottom-sheet: "Agent needs your login for *host*".
+3. Credential ENTRY happens OUTSIDE the agent surface: open login URL in **Custom Tab**
+   (`androidx.browser`) — user's own cookies, Android Autofill, passkeys — deep-link back
+   (`app://auth-callback`), signal session resume. Fallback: native `CredentialManager`
+   (passkey/password) sheet filling via CDP `DOM.setAttributeValue` without displaying the secret.
+4. Never type passwords into screencast/WebView agent surfaces; never log keystrokes.
+5. Post-login: explicit "control returned to agent" state + one-tap revoke.
+
+## 5. Security rules
+
+- CDP endpoint URL + headers stored encrypted; Tunnel URL pinned per server profile.
+- Screencast frames never cached to disk; memory-only, cleared on screen exit.
+- Audit-log browser-control sessions locally (when, which session, duration) — viewable in settings.
+
+## Sources
+
+- https://github.com/KevinnZou/compose-webview
+- https://github.com/novnc/noVNC (reference only — not used)
+- https://github.com/kklisura/chrome-devtools-java-client (optional)
+- Repo: `bin/bridge.ts`, `bin/cdp-mcp.ts` (existing CDP-bridge architecture)

+# 11 — Code hygiene (opencode sessions, backend connection, Android)
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Lint- and review-enforced.
+
+## 1. Connection code (S3 contract)
+
+- Single OkHttpClient (timeouts from settings); preemptive Basic + 401 Authenticator;
+  TLS only off-device; `network_security_config.xml` dev allowlist.
+- Repository per aggregate (`SessionRepository`, `MessageRepository`, …) behind `:domain` interfaces.
+- SSE manager: one EventSource lifecycle owner; backoff 1s→30s + jitter; resync via
+  `/session/status` + `GET message?limit=`; `?directory=` always; version pin from `/global/health`.
+- Defensive parsing: unknown event/part fields → log + skip, never crash. Contract tests against
+  recorded `/doc` fixtures per server version.
+- No `GlobalScope`; `viewModelScope`/`SupervisorJob`; cancel on `onCleared`.
+- Never spawn `serve` from the app; never call `/instance/dispose`; never blind `PATCH /config`.
+
+## 2. Session/message handling
+
+- `prompt_async` sends; reconcile on `session.idle`; optimistic message with rollback.
+- Deltas appended, never replaced; buffer ~100–200ms before recompose.
+- Model errors inside 200s render inline with retry (never toast-only).
+- Temp sessions filtered client-side (D2: hide locally); purge action + auto-purge setting.
+- Client-side Projects entity (D1) → dirs; memory/instructions injected as system context on send.
+
+## 3. Android hygiene
+
+- Hilt DI; no statics holding Context; `SavedStateHandle` for process-death survival.
+- Secrets: EncryptedSharedPreferences + Keystore; no secrets in logs/crash reports.
+- `FLAG_SECURE` on browser-observation + optional whole-app (setting).
+- Channels created once at install; WorkManager unique work names; FGS started only from visible activity.
+- Tests: VM + repo unit tests, MockWebServer fake-serve, theme screenshot tests,
+  manual Doze/OEM/device-lab matrix (doc 05 §6).
+
+## 4. Review gates (per phase, before user review)
+
+- `ktlint`/`detekt` clean; no hardcoded colors/strings/dimens in `:feature` (tokens only).
+- Smoke test on API-26 emulator + current-API emulator; screenshots attached in-session.
+- Cross-check touched IDs against grand-plan; fix deviations before handoff.

+# 12 — App optimization & techniques
+
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md.
+
+## 1. Startup
+
+- Baseline Profiles (compose + navigation paths) from P0; measure TTID on API-26 device.
+- Lazy-init: don't open SSE, don't load providers/agents/commands until server connected.
+- Hilt + R8 + App Bundle + per-ABI splits; keep `:app` wiring thin.
+
+## 2. List + render perf
+
+- LazyColumn stable `key(id)`; streaming buffer ~100–200ms; tail-only markdown re-parse
+  (`rememberStreamingMarkdownState`); Coil async images with size bounds; diff/patch collapsed default.
+- Avoid recomposition storms: hoist streaming state, use `derivedStateOf` for scroll-derived UI
+  (jump-to-latest FAB, date dividers).
+
+## 3. Network efficiency
+
+- `prompt_async` + SSE deltas (no polling loops); status-poll ONLY as SSE-drop fallback with backoff.
+- `GET message?limit=` paging; don't refetch full threads on every foreground (ETag/reconcile by `time.updated`).
+- Image attach compressed client-side before staging (setting); camera capture resolution capped (setting).
+
+## 4. Battery
+
+- SSE socket lifetime = chat screen visible (+ bounded FGS). Nothing periodic under 15 min;
+  WorkManager unique periodic ≥15min for widget status + health checks.
+- ntfy keepalives as health signal; `since=` backfill instead of re-pull storms.
+- Respect Doze: schedule, don't fight. Exemption is user-granted (D5), never assumed.
+
+## 5. Size
+
+- R8 full mode, resource shrinking, no unused deps; WebRTC/CDP libs loaded per-feature module
+  (dynamic-feature or on-demand) so base APK stays lean for non-browser users.
+- Prefer platform APIs (SpeechRecognizer, Photo Picker, CredentialManager) over SDK deps.
+
+## 6. Measurement
+
+- Per-phase: startup TTID (API 26 + current), APK size, SSE reconnect success rate,
+  scroll jank (frame timing) on streaming thread, battery Historian spot-checks on P4/P6.

+
+## 1. Vision & goals
+
+- G1: Match then beat Claude mobile app quality for remote opencode sessions (doc 01).
+- G2: Android-first, minSdk 26 support, easy + intuitive (docs 05, 08).
+- G3: Work from anywhere without PC — full PC-setup replacement: background tasks (P2),
+  notifications (P1), extended widget (P3), background health (P4).
+- Quality over speed; no token/resource economy; research newest Android constraints always (Q1).
+- No Firebase/paid; on-prem only; blackwall + `uchabokeria.space`; no Tailscale (T4).
+
+## 2. Locked decisions
+
+- D-Stack: 100% native Kotlin + Compose + M3 Expressive; minSdk 26; modules
+  `:app/:feature/:domain/:data` (doc 06). Locked 2026-10-04.
+- D-Push: self-hosted ntfy + `serve→ntfy` bridge on blackwall + UnifiedPush in app + FGS fallback (doc 09).
+- D-Perms: fully aggressive first-run onboarding (direct battery-exemption request; Play risk accepted;
+  sideload first). Decision D5 (docs 05, 13).
+- D-Temp (D2): temporary mode HIDES sessions locally (no server auto-delete) + purge action/setting.
+- D-Widget: extended — Claude 3 buttons + recent shortcuts + status (no version cuts; phases = build order).
+- D-Vim: full emulation as own workstream (library-first, expect custom InputConnection), non-blocking.
+- D1: Projects = client-side Room entity (memory/instructions per project) mapped to dirs,
+  injected as system context. Server Project = directory only.
+- D3: websearch toggle = per-message tools gating; memory toggle = simple-memory injection on/off;
+  permission default = PATCH /config rules; browser switch = /mcp + tools gating (verify live /doc).
+- D4: `/rc` + Tailscale flow keeps working until Tunnel cutover; then migrate.

+## 3. Topology (no Tailscale)

+- `pc.uchabokeria.space` → reserved for PC tunnel later (post-v1 scope, design keeps the slot).
