Repo: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client
Docs: `docs/RFC.md`, `docs/PRD.md` — https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client/blob/master/docs/RFC.md / `.../docs/PRD.md`

## 1. Retrofit interface

Source: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client/blob/master/app/src/main/java/com/yage/opencode_client/data/api/OpenCodeApi.kt (`app/.../data/api/OpenCodeApi.kt`)

All relative to `baseUrl/` (`OpenCodeRepository.buildRetrofit`, trims trailing `/`, prepends `http://` if missing).

| Method | Path | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `global/health` | — | `HealthResponse` |
| GET | `session?limit=` | — | `List<Session>` |
| POST | `session` | `CreateSessionRequest(title?, parentID?)` | `Session` |
| GET | `session/{id}` | — | `Session` |
| PATCH | `session/{id}` | `UpdateSessionRequest(title?, time.archived?)` | `Session` |
| DELETE | `session/{id}` | — | `Response<Unit>` |
| GET | `session/status` | — | `Map<String,SessionStatus>` |
| GET | `session/{id}/message?limit=` | — | `List<MessageWithParts>` (`info+parts`, not bare `Message`) |
| POST | `session/{id}/prompt_async` | `PromptRequest(messageID?, parts[], agent="build", model?)` | `Response<Unit>` (204 on accept, turn runs async) |
| POST | `session/{id}/abort` | — | `Response<Unit>` |
| POST | `session/{id}/fork` | `ForkSessionRequest(messageID?)` | `Session` (`"{title} (fork #N)"`) |
| POST | `session/{id}/revert` | `RevertSessionRequest(messageID, partID?)` | `Session` |
| POST | `session/{id}/permissions/{permissionId}` | `PermissionResponseRequest(response: "once"\|"always"\|"reject")` | `Response<Unit>` |
| GET | `permission` | — | `List<PermissionRequest>` |
| GET | `question` | — | `List<QuestionRequest>` |
| POST | `question/{requestId}/reply` | `QuestionReplyRequest(answers: List<List<String>>)` | `Response<Unit>` |
| POST | `question/{requestId}/reject` | — | `Response<Unit>` |
| GET | `config/providers` | — | `ProvidersResponse` |
| GET | `provider` | — | `ProviderRegistryResponse` (with `/config/providers` fallback, no connected-filter) |
| GET | `agent` | — | `List<AgentInfo>` |
| GET | `session/{id}/diff` | — | `List<FileDiff>` |
| GET | `session/{id}/todo` | — | `List<TodoItem>` |
| GET | `file?path=` | — | `List<FileNode>` |
| GET | `file/content?path=` | — | `FileContent` (base64 for images) |
| GET | `file/status` | — | `List<FileStatusEntry>` |
| GET | `find/file?query&limit=50` | — | `List<String>` |

`PromptRequest.PartInput`: `type="text"` default, `text?, mime?, filename?, url?`. File attach = `type="file", mime, filename, url=dataUrl` (`OpenCodeRepository.kt:sendMessage`). `ModelInput{providerID, modelID}`. JSON: `ignoreUnknownKeys+lenient+coerceInputValues`, `explicitNulls=false` (server rejects `model:null`), `encodeDefaults=true` (keeps part `type` discriminator) — `app/.../data/repository/OpenCodeRepository.kt:30`.

SSE is **not** Retrofit: `GET {base}/global/event`, OkHttp `EventSource`.

Key test contract: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client/blob/master/app/src/test/java/com/yage/opencode_client/OpenCodeRepositoryTest.kt:298 — asserts `POST /session/session-1/prompt_async` + `Authorization: Basic ...` + body contains `agent/type/text`.

## 2. SSE reconnect + resync

Source: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client/blob/master/app/src/main/java/com/yage/opencode_client/data/api/SSEClient.kt (`app/.../data/api/SSEClient.kt`), `app/.../data/repository/OpenCodeRepository.kt:235`, `app/.../ui/MainViewModelSyncActions.kt:1`

- Ctor takes only `OkHttpClient`. `connect(baseUrl, username?, password?, onConnected?)`.
- Backoff: `connectOnce(...).retryWhen{_,attempt -> delay((1000*2^attempt).coerceAtMost(30000)); true }` — 1s→2s→4s… cap 30s, **infinite**. `SSEClient.kt:32`.
- Request: `"$url/global/event"`, `Accept: text/event-stream`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, manual `Basic base64(u:p)` via `java.util.Base64`. `SSEClient.kt:50`.
- Listener: `onOpen→onConnected()`, `onEvent`: skip blank/`[DONE]`, `json.decodeFromString<SSEEvent>` (shared `Json`, `ignoreUnknownKeys/lenient/coerce`), `trySend(Result.success)`; malformed skipped silently. `onClosed→close(Exception)` (feeds `retryWhen`), `onFailure→close(t)`, `awaitClose{eventSource.cancel()}`.
- Dual clients in `OpenCodeRepository.kt:60`: REST read 60s, SSE read `0` (infinite); connect 15s, write 60s both; `BASIC` logging + Basic-auth interceptor; `configure()` normalizes URL + `rebuildClients()`.
- No `Last-Event-ID`. Resync = REST reconcile:
  - `launchSseCollection`: `repository.connectSSE(onConnected).catch{state.error}.collect{onEvent/onFailure}`.
  - `launchSseWatchdog` (`MainViewModelSyncActions.kt:50`): server 10s heartbeat on `/global/event`; if no frame >20s (and `lastFrameAtMs!=0`), one `loadMessages+loadSessionStatus` for current session (messages only if session not busy), touches timestamp.
  - `handleIncomingSseEvent`: `session.created/updated→upsert+refresh`, `session.status→update map; if current && !busy clear streaming overlays+refresh`, `message.created/updated→upsert info or REST refresh`, `message.part.delta→append to streamingPartTexts["$msg:$part"]` seeded from existing part text (anti-flash), `message.part.updated→Upsert/ShimDelta/RestFallback`, `removed→local delete`, `server.heartbeat→noop`, `todo.updated→sessionTodos+=`, `session.error→drop optimistic rows, return text to composer, error="Send failed: reason"`.
- Event model: `app/.../data/model/SSE.kt:4` (`SSEEvent(directory?, payload: SSEPayload)`).

## 3. ViewModel / state (chat + permissions)

Source: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client/blob/master/app/src/main/java/com/yage/opencode_client/ui/MainViewModel.kt (`app/.../ui/MainViewModel.kt`), `.../ui/MainViewModelSyncActions.kt`

- Single `@HiltViewModel MainViewModel` holding `MutableStateFlow(AppState)`; side-effects split to top-level helpers in `MainViewModelSyncActions.kt` (`handleIncomingSseEvent`, `launchSseCollection`, `launchSseWatchdog`).
- Derived slices: `connectionState/sessionState/chatState/speechState/fileUiState/settingsState`; `visibleMessages` filters post-`revert.messageId`; `availableModels = modelShortlist.map{toModelOption()}` (shortlist, not full registry); `contextUsage` from last assistant tokens vs provider limit; `sessionStats` rolls up `parentID` subtree; `attentionSessionIds = permission.sessionIds + question.sessionIds`.
- Core chat fields: `sessions, currentSessionId, sessionStatuses: Map<String,SessionStatus>, messages: List<MessageWithParts>, messageLimit=30, streamingPartTexts: Map<"msg:part",String>, streamingReasoningPart: Part?, partTypeIndex: Map<partId,type>, sendingSessionIds, pendingOptimisticMessageIds, sessionTodos: Map<String,List<TodoItem>>, inputText, imageAttachments`.
- Permissions: `pendingPermissions: List<PermissionRequest>`, `pendingQuestions: List<QuestionRequest>`. `permission.asked→loadPendingPermissions()` (`GET /permission`); `question.asked→append if new`, `question.replied/rejected→filter by requestID/id`. Respond: `repository.respondPermission→POST session/{id}/permissions/{pid} {response}`; `replyQuestion/rejectQuestion`.
- Models: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client/blob/master/app/src/main/java/com/yage/opencode_client/data/model/Permission.kt (`Permission.kt:1`: `id, sessionID, permission?, patterns?, metadata{filepath,parentDir}, always?, tool{messageID,callID}`; `PermissionResponse{ONCE="once",ALWAYS="always",REJECT="reject"}`), `.../data/model/Question.kt` (`QuestionRequest{id, sessionID, questions[{question,header,options[],multiple?,custom?}], tool?}`).
- UI: `ChatPermissionCard(permission, onRespond)` in `app/.../ui/chat/ChatInputBar.kt:569` — 3-button `REJECT/ONCE/ALWAYS`; mic permission via `RequestPermission()` in `app/.../ui/chat/ChatScreen.kt:54`.

## 4. Auth / storage / notification — worth copying

- **Auth** (`OpenCodeRepository.kt:60`, `SSEClient.kt:50`): nullable Basic Auth injected on both REST + SSE; `configure(url,u,p)` rebuilds clients. Copy the dual-client + normalize pattern. Test asserts header `Basic YWxpY2U6c2VjcmV0`.
- **Storage** (`app/.../util/SettingsManager.kt:1`): `EncryptedSharedPreferences("opencode_settings")`, `MasterKey AES256_GCM`, key `AES256_SIV`/value `AES256_GCM`. Keys: `server_url/username/password`, `host_profiles_json/current_host_profile_id`, `ssh_private_key_pem/ssh_public_key/ssh_known_hosts_json`, `basic_auth_password_<id>`, `session_id`, `session_drafts` (per-session `Map<String,String>`, blank removes), `session_model_ids/session_agents`, `model_shortlist.v1/selected_model_id`. Per-profile password by `passwordId`; export strips secrets. Backup exclusion worth copying: `app/src/main/res/xml/backup_rules.xml:1`, `data_extraction_rules.xml:1` (`exclude domain="sharedpref"`).
- **Network policy** (`app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml:1`): base `cleartext=false`; HTTP only `localhost/127.0.0.1/10.0.2.2/ts.net`. LAN IPs need HTTPS/Tailscale.
- **Host Profiles + SSH (RFC §3.5, draft Phase 8)**: `HostTransport{DIRECT,SSH_TUNNEL}`, `HostProfile{id,name,transport,serverURL,basicAuth{username,passwordId},ssh{host,port=8006,username=opencode,remotePort},lastUsedAt}`, `TunnelManager.ensureStarted()` idempotent (prefer local 4096, fallback random, runtime-only URL), phases `sshGateway/sshHostKey/sshAuth/localTunnel/health/connected`, JSch (`mwiede/JSch`) + BouncyCastle Ed25519 device key, TOFU known-hosts keyed `host:port`, iOS-compatible export JSON minus secrets.
- **Notifications: nothing to copy.** Explicit non-goal: no background SSE, no Foreground Service; background disconnects, foreground does REST full-sync + SSE rebuild (`PRD` 已决事项 6, RFC §3.3). `question`/permission wait with no push is a documented gap (“人机异步空转”).
- Also reusable: optimistic send + `session.error` text-recovery (`MainViewModelSyncActions.kt:185`); `visibleMessages`/revert filter; per-session draft + model/agent memory; deep links `opencode://session/<id>`, `opencode://prompt?a&p` + `pendingDeepLinkSessionId`; NFC quick-prompt byte budget 480/504 (`SettingsManager.kt:160`).

## A. alvarolorentedev/opencode-mobile

Repo: https://github.com/alvarolorentedev/opencode-mobile
Site: https://getopencode.app/ — docs at https://getopencode.app/docs/

**Onboarding flow steps** (`providers/onboarding-state.ts`, https://getopencode.app/docs/getting-started/):
- Install: Google Play (recommended), direct GitHub APK, iOS TestFlight. https://getopencode.app/docs/opencode-android-app/
- App first-run screens: **Welcome → Connect → Workspace → Preferences → Permissions → Ready**.
- Server prep: `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash`, then `opencode serve --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4096` with `OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME/PASSWORD` (or `opencode web` if browser UI also wanted). V1 + V2 contracts auto-detected.
- `CURRENT_ONBOARDING_VERSION = 1`, `0` = in-progress. Migration in `resolveOnboardingStatus`: existing settings/profiles/active-project → treated completed, fresh install → assistant. Storage failures fail-safe to completed.
- Connect → Workspace (refresh catalog, pick project, open/create session, remembers project + last session) → capabilities check (providers/models, realtime, MCP/LSP/formatter, VCS, worktrees, PTY) → first task in Chat (agent+model above composer, small verifiable prompt) → User Manual.

**Connection-profile fields** (`lib/connection-profiles.ts`, `providers/use-connection-profiles.ts`, https://getopencode.app/docs/remote-access/):
- `ConnectionProfile { id, name, serverUrl, username, connect?, modelPreferences? }`. `modelPreferences: { providerId, modelId, enabledModelIds, providerModelSelections, recentModelIds }` (partial, validated by `toConnectionProfile`, corrupt entries dropped).
- Password **never** in AsyncStorage model; per-profile SecureStore key `opencode-mobile.connection-profile-password.{id}` (`expo-secure-store` native; web test shim). Docs: non-secret details in app storage, passwords in secure store, notification records carry URL+username only, browser builds can't persist passwords.
- Doc-level triple: **Server URL** (origin + optional `/api` prefix, protocol normalized) + **Username** (`OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME`, blank → `opencode`) + **Password**. Test-and-connect, `Connected` status; editing alone doesn't reconnect. Multi-server: saved connections keep own sessions + model selection.
- `connect?` (Connect relay/subscription flow in `providers/use-connect-state.ts`): `{ controlPlaneUrl, machineId, machineName, deviceId (=username), expiresAt }`. Pairing-link/QR claim → `claimConnectPairing` → `saveConnectProfile`, hostname-mismatch guard, purchase/restore via native store.

**Permission card UX** (https://getopencode.app/docs/guides/approvals-and-changes/):
- Card shows operation + command/pattern/path. Actions: **Allow once / Always allow / Deny**. Guidance: prefer Allow once for destructive/unfamiliar/network/external-path.
- V1: composer approval toggle writes config (edit, shell, webfetch, loop, external dirs). V2: no config write → toggle hidden, per-request only.
- Question cards: single/multi/custom, answer in order, submit; Reject = don't continue. Conversation mode pauses for permission/question. Files Changed tab: count vs scope, expand per file, added/removed lines; diff is mobile triage, not desktop review. Pending items refreshed from realtime + list APIs; vanished = answered elsewhere → refresh. Light/dark screenshots on page.

**Usage/cost display** (https://getopencode.app/docs/guides/usage/):
- Tap usage indicator in Chat header → sheet (themed screenshots). Fields: **context utilization %**, input/output tokens, reasoning tokens (if provided), cache read/write, steps, **estimated cost only with usable server pricing**.
- Copy: "Pricing unavailable" ≠ free; "Included or unpriced" = subscription/missing pricing. Advice: fresh focused session, smaller model for follow-ups; provider dashboard is source of truth.

**QR/tunnel docs:**
- Standard self-host path has **no QR** — manual URL entry + `curl -u user:pass <base>/global/health` (`healthy:true`). QR/pairing link exists only in Connect flow (`pairLink`/`acceptLink`/`claimAction` in `use-connect-state.ts`).
- 3-step model: run → expose securely → connect. Methods: LAN `http://192.168.1.20:4096` (bind `0.0.0.0`, private firewall only); **Tailscale Serve** (preferred, `tailscale serve --bg 4096`, `https://...ts.net`, same tailnet) https://getopencode.app/docs/guides/tailscale/; **Cloudflare Tunnel** (temp `trycloudflare` disposable vs named tunnel, ingress → `127.0.0.1:4096`, auth mandatory, SSE/WebSocket must pass) https://getopencode.app/docs/guides/cloudflare-tunnel/; reverse proxy + `/api` prefix (prefix preserved for SDK/HTTP/`wss:` terminal) https://getopencode.app/docs/guides/reverse-proxy/; SSH forward (loopback). Troubleshooting: HTML/404 → wrong base vs `/api`; 401/403 → env creds; SSE/terminal stall → proxy dropped streaming. https://getopencode.app/docs/guides/troubleshooting/

## B. grinev/opencode-telegram-bot

Repo: https://github.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot
Concept: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot/main/CONCEPT.md (single CLI window in Telegram, DM-first, reply keyboard core, one active interaction)
Spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot/main/PRODUCT.md
Code: https://github.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot/tree/main/src (`src/bot/callbacks`, `handlers`, `menus`, `keyboards`, `services`)

**Permission approve/deny state machine** (`src/bot/callbacks/permission-callback-handler.ts`):
- Callback `permission:<once|always|reject>`. Guards: manager active → active message ID → non-empty requestIDs, else `permission.inactive_callback` alert.
- `markSending`; V2 `reject` settles whole session (`endSessionPrompts`). `opencodeClient.permission.reply({requestID, directory, reply})` per ID (directory = session.directory ?? project.worktree) in `safeBackgroundTask`.
- Outcomes: accepted / gone (`PermissionNotFoundError` → settled outside) / failed. Failed → prompt stays answerable + delivery warning, re-tap resends. Success → `endPrompt(replied)` → buttons stripped, terminal line records tapped vs outside vs `⏹ Not answered` (abort/detach/stop/restart/run-end). Reconnect re-shows one prompt per distinct pending request (identical grouped).

**Question handling** (`src/bot/callbacks/question-callback-handler.ts`):
- Callback `question:<select|submit|custom|toggle_custom|cancel>:<qIdx>[:opt]`. Single-select answers immediately and advances (`showNextQuestion`); multi-select toggles + re-renders, Done submits via `question.reply` (V2 sends value, shows label). Custom button only when allowed; typed text requires Custom first; multi-select custom becomes extra tickable row.
- Cancel → `question.reject` → `❌ Poll cancelled`, turn ends with no reply/footer. Last question stays until OpenCode takes answers, then summary. Undelivered → warning, stays answerable. Externally settled → buttons removed + line. Serialization: one slot, FIFO; same-session new question replaces poll, subagent question from another session waits; `/abort|/detach|/opencode_stop` drops waiting. Active flow blocks unrelated input (hint); allowed: `/help /status /abort /detach /opencode_stop`. Subagent questions render like main agent's.

**Queue-vs-steer** (`src/bot/handlers/prompt-queue-dispatch.ts`, `/settings`):
- Modes: Off | On (V1) | Queue|Steer (V2, default Steer). Cap `MAX_QUEUED_PROMPTS=5`; waiting items = bottom-keyboard buttons, tap to withdraw.
- V2: busy prompts go straight to session inbox, bot holds nothing (no media cap). Steer = picked up mid-turn, same progress message + one footer; Queue = own run after. Restart kills buttons but OpenCode still delivers; reconnect reconciles (delivered → no button/quote, still-waiting → button + later quote).
- V1: bot holds queue, dispatches one-by-one on idle with `dispatchInFlight` guard, echoes as external-user-input quote. 20 MiB raw `file_size` media cap pre-download; unsized media refused while busy.
- `/detach` hands waiting items to detached session (agent/model frozen at detach, incl. transcribing/downloading); they leave keyboard + cap; later switch leaves them; `/abort` there or `/opencode_stop` withdraws. Pickup while detached → background notification only.

**Session revert/fork** (`src/bot/callbacks/message-history-callback-handler.ts`, `/messages`):
- `/messages` lists user messages newest-first, paginated (`MESSAGES_LIST_LIMIT=10`), select → detail with full text + Revert/Fork/Back/Cancel. Blocked while foreground busy.
- Revert → `session.revert(sessionID, messageID, directory)`: rolls back, discards later. Fork → `session.fork(...)`: new session branched, original intact; bot sets current session, applies its agent/model/variant, re-attaches, refreshes keyboard/pinned, posts latest assistant reply.
- Related: `/sessions` + `/recent` (limit `SESSIONS_LIST_LIMIT=10`, running/idle/question/permission badges, subagent waits count to root), `/new /abort /detach`, `/projects /worktree /open /ls` (+📎 attach-to-next-prompt), `/rename /status`, `/commands /skills /mcps`, `/task|/tasklist` (≤10, ≥5min interval, 120min timeout), `/opencode_start|/opencode_stop`, `/reload` (V2).

**Model picker favorites+recent** (`src/bot/callbacks/model-selection-callback-handler.ts`):
- Source = OpenCode local `favorite` + `recent`. Favorites first, recents deduped, current `✅`, env `OPENCODE_MODEL_PROVIDER+ID` forced into favorites while offered. Only offered models shown; stale tap → silent redraw; stale selection → fallback to configured at start/`/reload` (kept first minute); session/agent switch with unoffered model → configured model.
- Paths: favorites/recent list → 🗂 Providers → provider page → model page (`MODELS_LIST_LIMIT=10`) with back buttons; search (`model:search` → text → results → select). Apply → keyboard + pinned context refresh → variant picker if >1 variant (`provider/id (variant)`), `Default`-only ends at confirmation. Agent pick applies its configured model/variant without opening variant menu.

- `GET /config`, `PATCH /config` (GET-then-merge, never blind overwrite).
- `GET /experimental/tool/ids`, `GET /experimental/tool?provider=&model=`;
  `GET /lsp|/formatter|/mcp`, `POST /mcp`; `POST /log`; `GET /doc`.
- Skip: `POST /instance/dispose` (kills server), `/tui/*` (desktop TUI),
  undocumented `/pty/*`, `/tui/publish`, `/tui/control/*`.

## 2. Gaps / risks

1. **Attachment upload RESOLVED (verified live 2026-10-04).** `FilePartInput{type:"file", mime, filename?, url}`
   with `url` = **`data:<mime>;base64,<bytes>`** stages correctly on the user message
   (verified: 1×1 PNG round-trips, `GET message` returns the file part with full data URL).
   No multipart endpoint; no `FilePartSource` needed for images. Client compresses/resizes
   BEFORE base64 (setting). Watch payload size on metered connections. `H2 UNBLOCKED`.
2. **No SSE resumption.** No Last-Event-ID/cursor/replay → resync via `/session/status` + `GET message?limit=`
   (`limit` is the only paging; large sessions may truncate).
3. **Schema drift v1 vs v2-fork.** revert/unrevert type, permission `remember?`, structured-output `format`
   already diverge → verify each against live `/doc`, gate on `/global/health` version, defensive-parse.
4. **Sync POST hangs.** Long-turn blocking call — mobile treats sync as optional/short-turn only.
5. **OAuth on device.** Browser-redirect-to-server flow → prefer API-key `PUT /auth/{id}`; deep-link plan B.
6. **Share = public** (opncd.ai) — confirm dialog + unshare required.
7. **`?directory=` omission** silently targets wrong cwd — always send.

## 3. Minimal flows

- Boot: health → `/project` → `/provider` + `/agent` + `/command` → open `/event` SSE.
- Chat: create/pick session → `GET message?limit=` → `prompt_async` → render deltas → `session.idle` → confirm GET.
- Approval: `permission.updated` → card → `POST …/permissions/{id}`.
- Interrupt/undo/branch/publish: abort / revert / fork / share (+unshare).

## Sources

- https://opencode.ai/docs/server/ · https://opencode.ai/docs/sdk/

# 14 — R11 teardown (file-level, verified 2026-10-04)

Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Teardown of the three reference implementations.
Read the repos directly for code; this doc captures what to copy and what to avoid.

## 1. grapeot/opencode_android_client (NATIVE BLUEPRINT — copy patterns)

Repo: https://github.com/grapeot/opencode_android_client (branch `master`, MIT, 97★)

### Files to study first

| File | Why |
|---|---|
| `app/.../data/api/OpenCodeApi.kt` | Full Retrofit interface (table below) |
| `app/.../data/api/SSEClient.kt` | OkHttp EventSource + infinite 1s→30s backoff + resync hooks |
| `app/.../data/repository/OpenCodeRepository.kt` | Dual-client (REST 60s / SSE infinite), Basic auth, `configure()` rebuild, optimistic send + `session.error` recovery |
| `app/.../ui/MainViewModel.kt` + `MainViewModelSyncActions.kt` | Single `StateFlow<AppState>`, `streamingPartTexts["msg:part"]` anti-flash, 20s SSE watchdog → REST reconcile |
| `app/.../data/model/SSE.kt`, `Permission.kt`, `Question.kt` | Event/part/permission/question models |
| `app/.../util/SettingsManager.kt` | EncryptedSharedPreferences + per-profile passwords + backup exclusion |
| `app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml` | `cleartext=false`, HTTP allowlist localhost/`10.0.2.2`/ts.net |
| `app/src/test/.../OpenCodeRepositoryTest.kt:298` | Test contract: `prompt_async` + Basic header + body shape |

### Endpoint table (verified against our live `/doc` — all exist on v1)

`GET global/health` · `GET session?limit=` · `POST session {title?,parentID?}` ·
`GET/PATCH/DELETE session/{id}` · `GET session/status` · `GET session/{id}/message?limit=` ·
`POST session/{id}/prompt_async {messageID?,parts[],agent="build",model?}` → 204 ·
`POST …/abort` · `POST …/fork {messageID?}` · `POST …/revert {messageID,partID?}` ·
`POST session/{id}/permissions/{pid} {response: once|always|reject}` ·
`GET /permission` + `POST /permission/{id}/reply {reply}` (PREFER — no session id; field is `reply`) ·
`GET /question` + `POST /question/{id}/reply {answers: string[][]}` + `POST …/reject` ·
`GET config/providers` (+ `GET /provider` fallback) · `GET /agent` · `GET …/diff` · `GET …/todo` ·
`GET /file?path=` · `GET /file/content?path=` (base64 images) · `GET /file/status` ·
`GET /find/file?query&limit=50`.

### JSON rules (copy verbatim)

`ignoreUnknownKeys + lenient + coerceInputValues`, `explicitNulls=false` (server rejects `model:null`),
`encodeDefaults=true` (keeps part `type` discriminator).

### SSE recipe (copy, then extend with FGS + ntfy)

- `GET {base}/global/event`, `Accept: text/event-stream`, manual Basic header.
- `retryWhen`: `delay((1000*2^attempt).coerceAtMost(30000))`, infinite.
- Skip blank/`[DONE]`; malformed frames skipped silently; `onClosed/onFailure` feed retry.
- Watchdog: server 10s heartbeat; no frame >20s → one REST reconcile (messages only if not busy).
- `message.part.delta` → append to `streamingPartTexts["$msg:$part"]` seeded from existing part text.
- `session.error` → drop optimistic rows, return text to composer, inline error.

### State model (adapt, don't clone)

Single `AppState` + derived slices; `visibleMessages` filters post-revert;
`attentionSessionIds = permission.sessionIds + question.sessionIds`;
per-session draft + model/agent memory; `contextUsage` from last assistant tokens vs provider limit;
`sessionStats` rolls up `parentID` subtree. Permission card: 3-button REJECT/ONCE/ALWAYS.
Deep links `opencode://session/<id>` (copy). NFC quick-prompt (skip).

### Explicit gaps THEY document (WE fill)

No background SSE, no FGS, no push — background disconnects, foreground full-syncs.
`question`/permission stalls with no push = "async idle" gap → our P4 (doc 09) exists because of this.
Voice needs external AI Builder → we use platform SpeechRecognizer (doc 08).

## 2. alvarolorentedev/opencode-mobile (UX + ONBOARDING — inspiration only, no code)

Repo: https://github.com/alvarolorentedev/opencode-mobile (Apache-2.0, 232★) · Docs: https://getopencode.app/docs/

- Onboarding: Welcome → Connect → Workspace → Preferences → Permissions → Ready;
  `CURRENT_ONBOARDING_VERSION` migration; fail-safe to completed. Copy the SEQUENCE, rewrite natively.
- Connection profiles: `{id, name, serverUrl, username, modelPreferences{…}}`;
  password NEVER in app storage — per-profile SecureStore key. Copy the MODEL (EncryptedSharedPreferences equivalent).
- Tunnel docs worth mirroring in our setup guide: LAN vs Tailscale vs Cloudflare Tunnel (named, auth mandatory,
  SSE/WebSocket must pass) vs reverse-proxy `/api` prefix vs SSH. Troubleshooting table
  (HTML/404 → wrong base; 401/403 → creds; SSE stall → proxy dropped streaming) → adapt to Tunnel-only.
- Permission cards: operation + pattern/path, Allow once / Always / Deny; prefer Allow-once guidance for
  destructive/network. Question cards: single/multi/custom, in-order, Reject ends turn.
- Usage sheet: context %, in/out/reasoning tokens, cache r/w, steps, cost ONLY with server pricing;
  "Pricing unavailable" ≠ free. Copy the copy.
- No QR in self-host path (manual URL + `curl -u … /global/health` check) → our X4 QR pairing is our own design.

## 3. grinev/opencode-telegram-bot (STATE MACHINES — read before P2 ViewModels)

Repo: https://github.com/grinev/opencode-telegram-bot (MIT, 1.2k★)

- Permissions (`permission-callback-handler.ts`): guards (manager→message→non-empty IDs);
  `PermissionNotFoundError` = settled elsewhere; failed → stays answerable + warning, re-tap resends;
  success → buttons stripped + terminal line records outcome; reconnect re-shows one prompt per pending request.
- Questions (`question-callback-handler.ts`): single-select answers+advances; multi toggles + Done;
  custom only when allowed; cancel → `question.reject` ends turn; last question stays until consumed;
  one slot FIFO; same-session replaces, subagent-from-other-session waits.
- Queue-vs-steer (`prompt-queue-dispatch.ts`): Steer (mid-turn pickup) vs Queue (own run after), cap 5;
  V2 busy → session inbox, bot holds nothing; restart/reconnect reconciliation rules.
- Revert/fork (`message-history-callback-handler.ts`): user-message list newest-first paginated;
  revert rolls back + discards later; fork branches + sets current + applies agent/model/variant.
- Model picker (`model-selection-callback-handler.ts`): favorites → recents deduped, current ✅,
  stale tap redraws, variant picker iff >1 variant, agent pick applies its model silently.

## 4. Copy checklist (into P0–P2 specs)

- [ ] Retrofit table + JSON rules + dual-client + `configure()` rebuild (P0)
- [ ] SSEClient backoff + watchdog + delta-append + error-recovery (P0/P1)
- [ ] EncryptedSharedPreferences keys + backup exclusion + network_security_config (P0)
- [ ] AppState slices + attention ids + drafts + model/agent memory (P1)
- [ ] Permission/question reply endpoints + grinev guards (P2)
- [ ] Onboarding sequence + tunnel troubleshooting (P0/X5)
- [ ] Usage-sheet copy + cost-honesty rules (P2/H10)

# 15 — Permission allowlist proposal (DRAFT for approval)

Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Status: PROPOSED — user approves in consult round 3 follow-up.
Unrestricted-default per brief; deny rules always win (server-enforced).

## Proposed defaults (opencode permission types → default action)

| Type | Default | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| `edit` (in-scope files) | ALLOW (remember) | Core agent loop; Claude parity (acceptEdits) |
| `read`, `glob`, `grep` | ALLOW (remember) | Read-only, zero risk |
| `bash` (safe read-only: ls, git status/diff/log, cat…) | ALLOW (remember) | Triage speed; still logged |
| `bash` (mutating: rm -rf, chmod, curl \| sh, sudo…) | ASK always | Destructive / exfiltration surface |
| `webfetch` | ALLOW (remember, websearch default-on H3) | Matches H3 default |
| `task`, `skill` (non-destructive) | ALLOW (remember) | Subagent delegation is normal work |
| `external_directory` (outside session dir) | ASK always | Sandbox escape |
| `doom_loop` | ASK always | Runaway-loop guard |
| `question` (AskUserQuestion) | ASK always (cards, never auto) | Needs human judgment by definition |
| `skill` (destructive/unknown) | ASK always | Unknown side effects |

## Rules

- Deny rules (server config) override everything, always.
- "Remember" (`always`) scoped per session by default; global-always requires explicit toggle (setting).
- Critical paths (`rm` on home/root, credential files) → ASK regardless of allowlist.
- Server `--auto` mode surfaced in UI banner (asks bypassed server-side except denys).
- Failed reply (e.g. `PermissionNotFoundError` = settled elsewhere) → card refreshes, stays answerable (grinev rule).

## Approval needed

User: approve table as-is, or adjust rows. Then it becomes the P2 permissions spec input.

input.content:
# SPEC — P0 scaffold (app boots, themes, servers connect)

Source of truth: `docs/grand-plan.md` §7. Implements: T1 (theme engine skeleton), T2 (neon default + light),
S1 (server profiles + switching), S2 (health/version pin), S3 (connection hardening), X1 (settings infra),
X5 (onboarding skeleton — full aggressive perms in P0b), doc 14 copy-checklist rows 1–3 + 6.

## 0. Toolchain (verified on this machine 2026-10-04)

- Android SDK `~/Android/Sdk`: platforms android-35 + android-36, build-tools 34/35/36.
- `local.properties`: `sdk.dir=/home/scriptkid/Android/Sdk` (generated, gitignored).
- AGP 8.13.x + Kotlin 2.2.x + JDK 17 (AGP requires 17; system java is 27 — set `org.gradle.java.home`
  to a JDK 17 path if present, else AGP toolchain; verify at scaffold).
- compileSdk 36, targetSdk 36 (verify Play requirement at build; 35 minimum), minSdk 26.
- No Kotlin/Flutter on PATH — Gradle downloads everything (wrapper pinned, hashes checked).

## 1. Module layout (doc 06)

```
mobile/
  app/                 (:app — Application, NavHost, DI wiring, onboarding)
  feature-servers/     (S1: profile list/add/edit/switch, health check UI)
  feature-settings/    (X1: DataStore settings + export/import screen skeleton)
  feature-theme/       (T1/T2: ThemeRepository, neon tokens doc 08 §2, light scheme)
  domain/              (pure Kotlin: ServerProfile, AppSettings, ThemeScheme models + repo interfaces)
  data/                (Retrofit OpenCodeApi per doc 14 §1 + JSON rules, EncryptedSharedPreferences
                        SettingsManager per doc 14 §4, network_security_config, S3 retry/backoff)
  gradle/libs.versions.toml (version catalog — ALL deps pinned here)
```

`:domain` has zero `androidx`/Android imports (unit-testable on JVM). Hilt across modules.

## 2. Deliverables (acceptance = all true)

1. `./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` green on this machine; APK installs on API-26 + API-36 emulators.
2. First-run onboarding (X5 skeleton): Welcome → Servers → Theme preview → Permissions (aggressive list
   incl. POST_NOTIFICATIONS rationale + battery-exemption settings intent D5) → Ready.
3. Server CRUD: add URL + user + password (encrypted, per-profile key), Test (`GET /global/health`
   → `healthy:true` + version shown), switch active server, delete. Tailscale URL works today;
   Tunnel URL field-ready.
4. Connection hardening (S3): preemptive Basic + 401 Authenticator; timeouts from settings;
   `?directory=` appended by interceptor (default server cwd); version pin stored per profile;
   `ignoreUnknownKeys/lenient/coerce`, `explicitNulls=false`, `encodeDefaults=true`.
5. Theme engine (T1/T2): `ThemeRepository` (DataStore) → CompositionLocal tokens → M3 Expressive;
   neon dark default (doc 08 §2 hexes verbatim) + light scheme + system-auto; no hardcoded colors in features.
6. Edge-to-edge from day one: `enableEdgeToEdge()` + per-screen insets; composer-less screens verified
   on gesture + 3-button nav (screenshot both).
7. Settings infra (X1): DataStore schema v1 (all doc-13 groups present even if few rows wired),
   export/import JSON working.
8. Tests: `:domain` unit tests; `:data` MockWebServer tests (health 200/401, `prompt_async` 204,
   Basic header assert — mirror grapeot `OpenCodeRepositoryTest.kt:298`); screenshot test of theme tokens.
9. Screenshots attached in-session: onboarding, server list, settings, neon chat-placeholder on API-26 + API-36.

## 3. Explicit non-goals (later phases)

Chat UI (P1), permissions/models/agents (P2), attachments/voice/projects/vim (P3), push/bridge/FGS/widget (P4),
browser/CDP (P5). No FGS, no UnifiedPush, no Room yet (profiles in EncryptedSharedPreferences per grapeot).

## 4. Risks

- AGP/Kotlin/JDK triad on Arch (JDK 27 default) — pin JDK 17 for Gradle, verify first build.
- M3 Expressive alpha API drift — pin version in catalog, isolate in `:feature-theme`.
- Emulator availability for API 26 — create AVDs now (`system-images;android-26;google_apis;x86_64`).

## 5. Review gate

ktlint/detekt clean · tests green · 2-emulator screenshots · grand-plan cross-check (§5: S1–S3, T1–T2, X1, X5-skeleton) · user review.

+package dev.opencode.remote
+
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.navigationBarsPadding
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.statusBarsPadding
+import androidx.compose.material3.Button
+import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
+import androidx.compose.material3.NavigationBar
+import androidx.compose.material3.NavigationBarItem
+import androidx.compose.material3.Scaffold
+import androidx.compose.material3.Text
+import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
+import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
+import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
+import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
+import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
+import androidx.hilt.navigation.compose.hiltViewModel
+import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost
+import androidx.navigation.compose.composable
+import androidx.navigation.compose.currentBackStackEntryAsState
+import androidx.navigation.compose.rememberNavController
+import dev.opencode.remote.servers.ServersScreen
+import dev.opencode.remote.settings.SettingsScreen
+import dev.opencode.remote.settings.SettingsViewModel
+
+private object Routes {
+    const val SERVERS = "servers"
+    const val ONBOARDING = "onboarding"
+    const val SETTINGS = "settings"
+}
+
+/** P0 nav: onboarding gate → servers (+ settings). Chat lands in P1. */
+@Composable
+fun AppNav() {
+    val nav = rememberNavController()
+    val settingsVm: SettingsViewModel = hiltViewModel()
+    val settings by settingsVm.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
+    val start = if (settings.onboardingDone) Routes.SERVERS else Routes.ONBOARDING
+
+    Scaffold(
+        bottomBar = {
+            val entry by nav.currentBackStackEntryAsState()
+            if (entry?.destination?.route != Routes.ONBOARDING) {
+                NavigationBar {
+                    NavigationBarItem(
+                        selected = entry?.destination?.route == Routes.SERVERS,
+                        onClick = { nav.navigate(Routes.SERVERS) { launchSingleTop = true } },
+                        icon = { Text("⌁") },
+                        label = { Text("Servers") },
+                    )
+                    NavigationBarItem(
+                        selected = entry?.destination?.route == Routes.SETTINGS,
+                        onClick = { nav.navigate(Routes.SETTINGS) { launchSingleTop = true } },
+                        icon = { Text("⚙") },
+                        label = { Text("Settings") },
+                    )
+                }
+            }
+        },
+    ) { inner ->
+        NavHost(nav, startDestination = start, Modifier.padding(inner)) {
+            composable(Routes.ONBOARDING) {
+                OnboardingScreen(onDone = {
+                    settingsVm.setOnboardingDone()
+                    nav.navigate(Routes.SERVERS) { popUpTo(Routes.ONBOARDING) { inclusive = true } }
+                })
+            }
+            composable(Routes.SERVERS) { ServersScreen() }
+            composable(Routes.SETTINGS) { SettingsScreen() }
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/** X5 skeleton: Welcome → Servers → Theme → Permissions → Ready (full aggressive perms in P0b). */
+@Composable
+private fun OnboardingScreen(onDone: () -> Unit) {
+    Column(
+        Modifier.fillMaxSize().statusBarsPadding().navigationBarsPadding().padding(24.dp),
+        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
+    ) {
+        Text("opencode", style = MaterialTheme.typography.displayMedium, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary)
+        Text("Your PC's agent, in your pocket. No cloud, no Firebase — your hardware.")
+        Text("1. Add your server (opencode.uchabokeria.space).")
+        Text("2. Pick the neon. More schemes later.")
+        Text("3. Grant permissions aggressively — notifications, mic, camera, battery.")
+        Text("4. Chat from anywhere (P1).")
+        Button(onClick = onDone) { Text("Get started") }
+    }
+}

+package dev.opencode.remote
+
+import android.os.Bundle
+import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
+import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
+import androidx.activity.enableEdgeToEdge
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
+import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
+import androidx.compose.runtime.collectAsState
+import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
+import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
+import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeMode
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeRepository
+import dev.opencode.remote.theme.OpencodeTheme
+import javax.inject.Inject
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
+
+@AndroidEntryPoint
+class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {
+
+    @Inject
+    lateinit var themes: ThemeRepository
+
+    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
+        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
+        enableEdgeToEdge() // forced posture (doc 05 §5, doc 08 §4)
+        setContent {
+            val themeState by combine(themes.schemeId, themes.mode) { a, b -> a to b }
+                .collectAsState(initial = "neon-dark" to ThemeMode.DARK)
+            val (schemeId, mode) = themeState
+            val scheme = themes.builtinSchemes().firstOrNull { it.id == schemeId }
+                ?: dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeScheme.NEON_DARK
+            OpencodeTheme(scheme = scheme, mode = mode) {
+                Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
+                    AppNav()
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

+package dev.opencode.remote.data.api
+
+import com.jakewharton.retrofit2.converter.kotlinx.serialization.asConverterFactory
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.AppSettings
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerProfile
+import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
+import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
+import okhttp3.Credentials
+import okhttp3.Interceptor
+import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
+import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
+import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
+import retrofit2.Retrofit
+
+/** Shared kotlinx.serialization config (doc 14 §1 — copy grapeot rules verbatim). */
+val OpenCodeJson = Json {
+    ignoreUnknownKeys = true
+    isLenient = true
+    coerceInputValues = true
+    explicitNulls = false
+    encodeDefaults = true
+}
+
+private const val JSON_MIME = "application/json"
+
+/** Builds the S3-hardened client: Basic auth, timeouts from settings, `?directory=` routing. */
+object ApiFactory {
+    fun retrofit(profile: ServerProfile, password: String?, settings: AppSettings): Retrofit {
+        val base = profile.baseUrl.trimEnd('/') + "/"
+        val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
+            .connectTimeout(settings.connectTimeoutMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
+            .readTimeout(settings.readTimeoutMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
+            .writeTimeout(settings.readTimeoutMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
+            .addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor(profile.username, password))
+            .addInterceptor(DirectoryInterceptor(profile.defaultDirectory))
+            .apply {
+                if (BuildConfigField.DEBUG_LOGGING) {
+                    addInterceptor(HttpLoggingInterceptor().setLevel(HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BASIC))
+                }
+            }
+            .authenticator { _, response ->
+                if (response.request.header("Authorization") != null || password.isNullOrEmpty()) return@authenticator null
+                response.request.newBuilder()
+                    .header("Authorization", Credentials.basic(profile.username, password))
+                    .build()
+            }
+            .build()
+        return Retrofit.Builder()
+            .baseUrl(base)
+            .client(client)
+            .addConverterFactory(OpenCodeJson.asConverterFactory(JSON_MIME.toMediaType()))
+            .build()
+    }
+
+    fun api(profile: ServerProfile, password: String?, settings: AppSettings): OpenCodeApi =
+        retrofit(profile, password, settings).create(OpenCodeApi::class.java)
+}
+
+/** Preemptive Basic auth (grapeot pattern: nullable creds, works without password for local dev). */
+private class AuthInterceptor(val user: String, val password: String?) : Interceptor {
+    override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain) =
+        chain.proceed(
+            if (password.isNullOrEmpty()) chain.request()
+            else chain.request().newBuilder()
+                .header("Authorization", Credentials.basic(user, password))
+                .build(),
+        )
+}
+
+/** Appends `?directory=` when the profile pins one (doc 07: never target the wrong cwd). */
+private class DirectoryInterceptor(val directory: String?) : Interceptor {
+    override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): okhttp3.Response {
+        val req = chain.request()
+        if (directory.isNullOrBlank() || req.url.queryParameter("directory") != null) {
+            return chain.proceed(req)
+        }
+        val url = req.url.newBuilder().addQueryParameter("directory", directory).build()
+        return chain.proceed(req.newBuilder().url(url).build())
+    }
+}
+
+/** Build-time debug flag without depending on :app BuildConfig. */
+internal object BuildConfigField {
+    const val DEBUG_LOGGING = true
+}

+package dev.opencode.remote.data.api
+
+import kotlinx.serialization.SerialName
+import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
+import retrofit2.Response
+import retrofit2.http.Body
+import retrofit2.http.DELETE
+import retrofit2.http.GET
+import retrofit2.http.PATCH
+import retrofit2.http.POST
+import retrofit2.http.Path
+
+/**
+ * opencode `serve` v1 HTTP contract (doc 07, frozen spec assets/serve-spec-1.0.0-dev.json,
+ * teardown doc 14 §1). P0 ships health + profiles; chat/session calls land in P1.
+ */
+interface OpenCodeApi {
+    @GET("global/health")
+    suspend fun health(): HealthResponse
+
+    // --- P1 surface (declared now so MockWebServer tests pin the paths) ---
+    @GET("session")
+    suspend fun sessions(): List<SessionDto>
+
+    @POST("session")
+    suspend fun createSession(@Body body: CreateSessionRequest): SessionDto
+
+    @GET("session/{id}")
+    suspend fun session(@Path("id") id: String): SessionDto
+
+    @PATCH("session/{id}")
+    suspend fun renameSession(@Path("id") id: String, @Body body: UpdateTitleRequest): SessionDto
+
+    @DELETE("session/{id}")
+    suspend fun deleteSession(@Path("id") id: String): Response<Unit>
+
+    @GET("session/status")
+    suspend fun sessionStatus(): Map<String, SessionStatusDto>
+
+    @POST("session/{id}/prompt_async")
+    suspend fun promptAsync(@Path("id") id: String, @Body body: PromptRequest): Response<Unit>
+
+    @GET("permission")
+    suspend fun pendingPermissions(): List<PermissionDto>
+
+    @POST("permission/{requestId}/reply")
+    suspend fun replyPermission(
+        @Path("requestId") requestId: String,
+        @Body body: PermissionReply,
+    ): Response<Unit>
+}
+
+@Serializable
+data class HealthResponse(val healthy: Boolean, val version: String)
+
+@Serializable
+data class SessionDto(
+    val id: String,
+    val title: String = "",
+    val directory: String = "",
+    val projectID: String = "",
+)
+
+@Serializable
+data class CreateSessionRequest(val title: String? = null, val parentID: String? = null)
+
+@Serializable
+data class UpdateTitleRequest(val title: String)
+
+@Serializable
+data class SessionStatusDto(val type: String = "idle")
+
+@Serializable
+data class PromptRequest(
+    val parts: List<PartInput>,
+    val agent: String = "build",
+    val model: ModelInput? = null,
+    val noReply: Boolean = false,
+)
+
+@Serializable
+data class PartInput(
+    val type: String = "text",
+    val text: String? = null,
+    val mime: String? = null,
+    val filename: String? = null,
+    val url: String? = null,
+)
+
+@Serializable
+data class ModelInput(val providerID: String, val modelID: String)
+
+@Serializable
+data class PermissionDto(val id: String, val sessionID: String = "", val title: String = "")
+
+@Serializable
+data class PermissionReply(
+    val reply: String,
+    val message: String? = null,
+)

+package dev.opencode.remote.data.store
+
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.SharedPreferences
+import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
+import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey
+import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.AppSettings
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerProfile
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerRepository
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.SettingsRepository
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeMode
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeRepository
+import javax.inject.Inject
+import javax.inject.Singleton
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
+import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
+import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
+
+private const val PREFS = "opencode_remote"
+private const val KEY_PROFILES = "profiles_json"
+private const val KEY_ACTIVE = "active_profile"
+private const val KEY_SETTINGS = "settings_json"
+private const val KEY_THEME_SCHEME = "theme_scheme"
+private const val KEY_THEME_MODE = "theme_mode"
+private const val PASS_PREFIX = "profile_pass_"
+
+private val plainJson = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
+
+/**
+ * Encrypted profile + settings store (grapeot SettingsManager pattern, doc 14 §4).
+ * Passwords under per-profile keys; export strips secrets (X1).
+ */
+@Singleton
+class SecureStore @Inject constructor(@ApplicationContext context: Context) :
+    ServerRepository, SettingsRepository, ThemeRepository {
+
+    private val prefs: SharedPreferences by lazy {
+        EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
+            context,
+            PREFS,
+            MasterKey.Builder(context).setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM).build(),
+            EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
+            EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM,
+        )
+    }
+
+    private val _profiles = MutableStateFlow(loadProfiles())
+    override val profiles: Flow<List<ServerProfile>> = _profiles.asStateFlow()
+
+    private val _activeId = MutableStateFlow(prefsString(KEY_ACTIVE))
+    override val activeProfileId: Flow<String?> = _activeId.asStateFlow()
+
+    private val _settings = MutableStateFlow(loadSettings())
+    override val settings: Flow<AppSettings> = _settings.asStateFlow()
+
+    // --- ServerRepository ---
+    override suspend fun upsertProfile(profile: ServerProfile, password: String?) {
+        _profiles.update { list ->
+            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
+            val stamped = profile.copy(lastUsedAt = now)
+            if (list.any { it.id == profile.id }) list.map { if (it.id == profile.id) stamped else it }
+            else list + stamped
+        }
+        persistProfiles()
+        if (password != null) prefs.edit().putString(PASS_PREFIX + profile.id, password).apply()
+    }
+
+    override suspend fun deleteProfile(id: String) {
+        _profiles.update { it.filterNot { p -> p.id == id } }
+        persistProfiles()
+        prefs.edit().remove(PASS_PREFIX + id).apply()
+        if (_activeId.value == id) setActiveProfile(null)
+    }
+
+    override suspend fun setActiveProfile(id: String?) {
+        _activeId.value = id
+        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_ACTIVE, id).apply()
+    }
+
+    override suspend fun getPassword(profileId: String): String? =
+        prefs.getString(PASS_PREFIX + profileId, null)
+
+    override suspend fun checkHealth(profile: ServerProfile): Result<dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerHealth> =
+        runCatching {
+            val settings = _settings.value
+            val api = dev.opencode.remote.data.api.ApiFactory.api(profile, getPassword(profile.id), settings)
+            val h = api.health()
+            dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerHealth(h.healthy, h.version)
+        }
+
+    // --- SettingsRepository ---
+    override suspend fun update(transform: (AppSettings) -> AppSettings) {
+        _settings.update(transform)
+        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_SETTINGS, plainJson.encodeToString(AppSettings.serializer(), _settings.value)).apply()
+    }
+
+    override suspend fun exportJson(): String =
+        plainJson.encodeToString(AppSettings.serializer(), _settings.value)
+
+    override suspend fun importJson(json: String): Result<Unit> = runCatching {
+        val parsed = plainJson.decodeFromString(AppSettings.serializer(), json)
+        _settings.value = parsed
+        prefs.edit().putString(KEY_SETTINGS, json).apply()
+    }
+
+    // --- ThemeRepository ---
+    override val schemeId: Flow<String> = settings.map { it.themeSchemeId }
+    override val mode: Flow<ThemeMode> = settings.map { it.themeMode }
+
+    override suspend fun setScheme(id: String) = update { it.copy(themeSchemeId = id) }
+    override suspend fun setMode(mode: ThemeMode) = update { it.copy(themeMode = mode) }
+    override fun builtinSchemes() = listOf(
+        dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeScheme.NEON_DARK,
+        dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeScheme.NEON_LIGHT,
+    )
+
+    // --- internals ---
+    private fun prefsString(key: String): String? = try {
+        prefs.getString(key, null)
+    } catch (_: Exception) {
+        null
+    }
+
+    private fun loadProfiles(): List<ServerProfile> = try {
+        prefsString(KEY_PROFILES)?.let {
+            plainJson.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(ServerProfile.serializer()), it)
+        } ?: emptyList()

+package dev.opencode.remote.data.api
+
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.AppSettings
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerProfile
+import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
+import mockwebserver3.MockResponse
+import mockwebserver3.MockWebServer
+import org.junit.After
+import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
+import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
+import org.junit.Before
+import org.junit.Test
+
+/** Wire-contract tests: paths, Basic auth, bodies (mirror grapeot OpenCodeRepositoryTest). */
+class OpenCodeApiTest {
+
+    private lateinit var server: MockWebServer
+
+    @Before
+    fun setUp() {
+        server = MockWebServer()
+        server.start()
+    }
+
+    @After
+    fun tearDown() {
+        server.close()
+    }
+
+    private fun api(user: String = "ucha", pass: String? = "secret") =
+        ApiFactory.api(
+            ServerProfile(id = "p1", name = "t", baseUrl = server.url("/").toString(), username = user),
+            pass,
+            AppSettings(),
+        )
+
+    @Test
+    fun healthParses() = runTest {
+        server.enqueue(MockResponse(body = """{"healthy":true,"version":"9.9.9"}"""))
+        val h = api().health()
+        assertTrue(h.healthy)
+        assertEquals("9.9.9", h.version)
+        val req = server.takeRequest()
+        assertEquals("/global/health", req.target)
+        assertEquals("Basic dWNoYTpzZWNyZXQ=", req.headers["Authorization"])
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun promptAsyncPosts204WithAgentAndParts() = runTest {
+        server.enqueue(MockResponse(code = 204))
+        val res = api().promptAsync(
+            "ses_1",
+            PromptRequest(parts = listOf(PartInput(type = "text", text = "hi")), agent = "build"),
+        )
+        assertEquals(204, res.code())
+        val req = server.takeRequest()
+        assertEquals("/session/ses_1/prompt_async", req.target)
+        val body = req.body?.utf8() ?: ""
+        assertTrue(body.contains("\"agent\":\"build\""))
+        assertTrue(body.contains("\"type\":\"text\""))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun permissionReplyUsesReplyField() = runTest {
+        server.enqueue(MockResponse(body = "true"))
+        api().replyPermission("prm_1", PermissionReply(reply = "once"))
+        val req = server.takeRequest()
+        assertEquals("/permission/prm_1/reply", req.target)
+        assertTrue((req.body?.utf8() ?: "").contains("\"reply\":\"once\""))
+    }
+
+    @Test
+    fun directoryInterceptorAppendsDirectory() = runTest {
+        server.enqueue(MockResponse(body = """{"healthy":true,"version":"x"}"""))
+        val profile = ServerProfile(
+            id = "p1", name = "t", baseUrl = server.url("/").toString(),
+            username = "u", defaultDirectory = "/home/u/proj",
+        )
+        ApiFactory.api(profile, null, AppSettings()).health()
+        val req = server.takeRequest()
+        assertTrue((req.target ?: "").contains("directory=%2Fhome%2Fu%2Fproj"))
+    }
+}

+package dev.opencode.remote.servers
+
+import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.navigationBarsPadding
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
+import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.statusBarsPadding
+import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
+import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
+import androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
+import androidx.compose.material3.Button
+import androidx.compose.material3.Card
+import androidx.compose.material3.ExperimentalMaterial3Api
+import androidx.compose.material3.FloatingActionButton
+import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme

+import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
+import androidx.compose.material3.Scaffold
+import androidx.compose.material3.Text
+import androidx.compose.material3.TextButton
+import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
+import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
+import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
+import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
+import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
+import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
+import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
+import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.PasswordVisualTransformation
+import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
+import androidx.hilt.navigation.compose.hiltViewModel
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ConnectionState
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerProfile
+
+/** S1: server list + add/edit + switch. Edge-to-edge insets per-screen (doc 08 §4). */
+@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
+@Composable
+fun ServersScreen(vm: ServersViewModel = hiltViewModel()) {
+    val state by vm.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
+    var editing by remember { mutableStateOf<ServerProfile?>(null) }
+    var adding by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
+
+    Scaffold(
+        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
+        topBar = {
+            Column(Modifier.statusBarsPadding().padding(16.dp)) {
+                Text("Servers", style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium)
+                Text(
+                    connectionLine(state.connection),
+                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
+                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary,
+                )
+            }
+        },
+        floatingActionButton = {
+            FloatingActionButton(onClick = { adding = true }) { Text("+") }
+        },
+    ) { inner ->
+        LazyColumn(
+            modifier = Modifier.padding(inner).navigationBarsPadding().fillMaxSize(),
+            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
+        ) {
+            items(state.profiles, key = { it.id }) { profile ->
+                Card(
+                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 16.dp)
+                        .clickable { vm.setActive(profile.id) },
+                ) {
+                    Column(Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
+                        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
+                            Text(profile.name, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
+                            if (profile.id == state.activeId) Text("● active", color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.tertiary)
+                        }
+                        Text(profile.baseUrl, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
+                        Text(
+                            "user ${profile.username}" +
+                                (profile.serverVersion?.let { " · v$it" } ?: ""),
+                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
+                        )
+                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
+                            OutlinedButton(onClick = { vm.checkHealth(profile.id) }) { Text("Test") }
+                            OutlinedButton(onClick = { editing = profile }) { Text("Edit") }
+                            OutlinedButton(onClick = { vm.deleteProfile(profile.id) }) { Text("Delete") }
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (adding || editing != null) {
+        ServerEditor(
+            existing = editing,
+            onDismiss = { adding = false; editing = null },
+            onSave = { name, url, user, pass, dir ->
+                vm.saveProfile(editing, name, url, user, pass, dir)
+                adding = false; editing = null
+            },
+        )
+    }
+}
+
+private fun connectionLine(c: ConnectionState): String = when (c) {
+    ConnectionState.Disconnected -> "disconnected"
+    ConnectionState.Connecting -> "connecting…"
+    is ConnectionState.Connected -> "connected · v${c.health.version}"
+    is ConnectionState.Failed -> "failed: ${c.reason}"
+}
+
+@Composable
+private fun ServerEditor(
+    existing: ServerProfile?,
+    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
+    onSave: (name: String, url: String, user: String, pass: String, dir: String) -> Unit,
+) {
+    var name by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.name ?: "") }
+    var url by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.baseUrl ?: "https://opencode.uchabokeria.space") }
+    var user by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.username ?: "opencode") }
+    var pass by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
+    var dir by remember { mutableStateOf(existing?.defaultDirectory ?: "") }
+    AlertDialog(
+        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
+        title = { Text(if (existing == null) "Add server" else "Edit server") },
+        text = {
+            Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
+                OutlinedTextField(name, { name = it }, label = { Text("Name") })
+                OutlinedTextField(url, { url = it }, label = { Text("Base URL") })
+                OutlinedTextField(user, { user = it }, label = { Text("Username") })
+                OutlinedTextField(
+                    pass, { pass = it }, label = { Text("Password (blank keeps saved)") },
+                    visualTransformation = PasswordVisualTransformation(),
+                )
+                OutlinedTextField(dir, { dir = it }, label = { Text("Default directory (optional)") })
+            }
+        },
+        confirmButton = {
+            Button(
+                onClick = { onSave(name, url, user, pass, dir) },
+                enabled = name.isNotBlank() && url.isNotBlank(),
+            ) { Text("Save & connect") }
+        },
+        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text("Cancel") } },
+    )
+}

+package dev.opencode.remote.servers
+
+import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
+import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
+import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ConnectionState
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerProfile
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ServerRepository
+import java.util.UUID
+import javax.inject.Inject
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
+import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
+import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
+
+data class ServerUiState(
+    val profiles: List<ServerProfile> = emptyList(),
+    val activeId: String? = null,
+    val connection: ConnectionState = ConnectionState.Disconnected,
+)
+
+/** S1/S2: profile CRUD + active switching + health check. */
+@HiltViewModel
+class ServersViewModel @Inject constructor(
+    private val servers: ServerRepository,
+) : ViewModel() {
+
+    private val _connection = MutableStateFlow<ConnectionState>(ConnectionState.Disconnected)
+    val connection = _connection.asStateFlow()
+
+    val uiState: StateFlow<ServerUiState> = combine(
+        servers.profiles, servers.activeProfileId, _connection,
+    ) { profiles, activeId, connection ->
+        ServerUiState(profiles, activeId, connection)
+    }.stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), ServerUiState())
+
+    fun saveProfile(
+        existing: ServerProfile?,
+        name: String,
+        baseUrl: String,
+        username: String,
+        password: String,
+        defaultDirectory: String?,
+    ) {
+        viewModelScope.launch {
+            val profile = (existing ?: ServerProfile(
+                id = UUID.randomUUID().toString(),
+                name = "",
+                baseUrl = "",
+            )).copy(
+                name = name.trim(),
+                baseUrl = baseUrl.trim().trimEnd('/'),
+                username = username.trim().ifBlank { "opencode" },
+                defaultDirectory = defaultDirectory?.trim().orEmpty().ifBlank { null },
+            )
+            servers.upsertProfile(profile, password.ifBlank { null })
+            servers.setActiveProfile(profile.id)
+            checkHealth(profile.id)
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun deleteProfile(id: String) {
+        viewModelScope.launch { servers.deleteProfile(id) }
+    }
+
+    fun setActive(id: String) {
+        viewModelScope.launch {
+            servers.setActiveProfile(id)
+            checkHealth(id)
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun checkHealth(id: String) {
+        viewModelScope.launch {
+            _connection.value = ConnectionState.Connecting
+            val profile = servers.profilesSnapshot(id) ?: run {
+                _connection.value = ConnectionState.Failed("profile not found")
+                return@launch
+            }
+            servers.checkHealth(profile).fold(
+                onSuccess = { _connection.value = ConnectionState.Connected(it) },
+                onFailure = { _connection.value = ConnectionState.Failed(it.message ?: "unreachable") },
+            )
+        }
+    }
+
+    fun disconnect() {
+        _connection.value = ConnectionState.Disconnected
+    }
+}
+
+private suspend fun ServerRepository.profilesSnapshot(id: String): ServerProfile? =
+    profiles.first().firstOrNull { it.id == id }

Index: opencode/mobile/android/feature-theme/src/main/kotlin/dev/opencode/remote/theme/OpencodeTheme.kt
===================================================================
--- opencode/mobile/android/feature-theme/src/main/kotlin/dev/opencode/remote/theme/OpencodeTheme.kt	
+++ opencode/mobile/android/feature-theme/src/main/kotlin/dev/opencode/remote/theme/OpencodeTheme.kt

+package dev.opencode.remote.theme
+
+import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
+import androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme
+import androidx.compose.material3.lightColorScheme
+import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
+import androidx.compose.runtime.CompositionLocalProvider
+import androidx.compose.runtime.compositionLocalOf
+import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
+import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
+import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeMode
+import dev.opencode.remote.domain.ThemeScheme
+
+/** Extra neon tokens beyond M3 (glow + accent). Engine reads ThemeScheme (T1). */
+data class NeonTokens(
+    val glow: Color,
+    val accentCyan: Color = Color(0xFF00F0FF),
+    val accentMagenta: Color = Color(0xFFB537F2),
+    val accentAcid: Color = Color(0xFF39FF14),
+)
+
+val LocalNeon = compositionLocalOf {
+    NeonTokens(glow = Color(0xFF00F0FF))
+}
+
+private fun ThemeScheme.toDarkScheme() = darkColorScheme(
+    primary = Color(primary),
+    secondary = Color(secondary),
+    tertiary = Color(tertiary),
+    background = Color(background),
+    surface = Color(surface),
+    error = Color(error),
+    onPrimary = Color.Black,
+    onSecondary = Color.Black,
+    onBackground = Color(0xFFE8E6F5),
+    onSurface = Color(0xFFE8E6F5),
+)
+
+private fun ThemeScheme.toLightScheme() = lightColorScheme(
+    primary = Color(primary),
+    secondary = Color(secondary),
+    tertiary = Color(tertiary),
+    background = Color(background),
+    surface = Color(surface),
+    error = Color(error),
+    onPrimary = Color.White,
+    onBackground = Color(0xFF14121F),
+    onSurface = Color(0xFF14121F),
+)
+
+/**
+ * App theme entry (T1/T2). All feature screens use this — never raw colors.
+ * Reduced motion / font scale applied by callers via settings (doc 13).
+ */
+@Composable
+fun OpencodeTheme(
+    scheme: ThemeScheme = ThemeScheme.NEON_DARK,
+    mode: ThemeMode = ThemeMode.DARK,
+    useDarkTheme: Boolean = when (mode) {
+        ThemeMode.DARK -> true
+        ThemeMode.LIGHT -> false
+        ThemeMode.SYSTEM -> androidx.compose.foundation.isSystemInDarkTheme()
+    },
+    content: @Composable () -> Unit,
+) {
+    val colorScheme = remember(scheme, useDarkTheme) {
+        if (useDarkTheme) scheme.toDarkScheme() else scheme.toLightScheme()
+    }
+    val neon = remember(scheme) {
+        NeonTokens(glow = if (scheme.glowEnabled) Color(scheme.primary) else Color.Transparent)
+    }
+    CompositionLocalProvider(LocalNeon provides neon) {
+        MaterialTheme(
+            colorScheme = colorScheme,
+            typography = MaterialTheme.typography.copy(
+                bodyLarge = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge.copy(
+                    fontSize = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge.fontSize * scheme.fontScale,
+                    lineHeight = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge.lineHeight * scheme.fontScale,
+                ),
+            ),
+            content = content,
+        )

+##############################################################################
+#
+#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
+#
+#   Important for running:
+#
+#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
+#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
+#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
+#       command line, like:
+#
+#           ksh Gradle
+#
+#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
+#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
+#         * functions;
+#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
+#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
+#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
+#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
+#
+#   Important for patching:
+#
+#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
+#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
+#
+#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
+#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
+#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
+#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
+#
+#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
+#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
+#       see the in-line comments for details.
+#
+#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
+#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
+#
+#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
+#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
+#       within the Gradle project.
+#
+#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
+#
+##############################################################################
+
+# Attempt to set APP_HOME
+
+# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
+app_path=$0
+
+# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
+while
+    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
+    [ -h "$app_path" ]
+do
+    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
+    link=${ls#*' -> '}
+    case $link in             #(
+      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
+      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
+    esac
+done
+
+# This is normally unused
+# shellcheck disable=SC2034
+APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
+# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
+APP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf '%s
+' "$PWD" ) || exit
+
+# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
+MAX_FD=maximum
+
+warn () {
+    echo "$*"
+} >&2
+
+die () {
+    echo
+    echo "$*"
+    echo
+    exit 1
+} >&2
+
+# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
+cygwin=false
+msys=false
+darwin=false
+nonstop=false
+case "$( uname )" in                #(
+  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
+  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
+  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
+  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
+esac
+
+CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar
+
+
+# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
+if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
+    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
+        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
+        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
+    else
+        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
+    fi
+    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
+        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME
+
+Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
+location of your Java installation."
+    fi
+else
+    JAVACMD=java
+    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
+    then
+        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.
+
+Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
+location of your Java installation."
+    fi
+fi
+
+# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
+if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
+    case $MAX_FD in #(
+      max*)
+        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
+        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
+        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
+            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
+    esac
+    case $MAX_FD in  #(
+      '' | soft) :;; #(
+      *)
+        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
+        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
+        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
+            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
+    esac
+fi
+
+# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
+#   * args from the command line
+#   * the main class name
+#   * -classpath
+#   * -D...appname settings
+#   * --module-path (only if needed)
+#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.
+
+# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
+if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
+    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
+    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )
+
+    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )
+
+    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
+    for arg do
+        if
+            case $arg in                                #(
+              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
+              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
+                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
+              *)    false ;;
+            esac
+        then
+            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
+        fi
+        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
+        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
+        # possibly modified.
+        #
+        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
+        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
+        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
+        shift                   # remove old arg
+        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
+    done
+fi
+
+
+# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
+DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'
+
+# Collect all arguments for the java command:
+#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
+#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
+#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
+#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.
+
+set -- \
+        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
+        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
+        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \
+        "$@"
+
+# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
+if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
+then
+    die "xargs is not available"
+fi
+
+# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
+#
+# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
+#
+# In Bash we could simply go:
+#
+#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
+#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
+#
+# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
+# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
+# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
+# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
+# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
+#
+# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
+# an unmatched quote.
+#
+
+eval "set -- $(
+        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
+        xargs -n1 |
+        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
+        tr '\n' ' '
+    )" '"$@"'
+
+exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

 # 15 — Permission allowlist proposal (DRAFT for approval)
 
-Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Status: PROPOSED — user approves in consult round 3 follow-up.
+Source of truth: grand-plan.md. Status: APPROVED 2026-10-04 (round 3 follow-up, as-is).
 Unrestricted-default per brief; deny rules always win (server-enforced).
 
 ## Proposed defaults (opencode permission types → default action)
 
 | Type | Default | Rationale |
 |---|---|---|
 | `edit` (in-scope files) | ALLOW (remember) | Core agent loop; Claude parity (acceptEdits) |
 | `read`, `glob`, `grep` | ALLOW (remember) | Read-only, zero risk |
 | `bash` (safe read-only: ls, git status/diff/log, cat…) | ALLOW (remember) | Triage speed; still logged |
 | `bash` (mutating: rm -rf, chmod, curl \| sh, sudo…) | ASK always | Destructive / exfiltration surface |
 | `webfetch` | ALLOW (remember, websearch default-on H3) | Matches H3 default |
 | `task`, `skill` (non-destructive) | ALLOW (remember) | Subagent delegation is normal work |
 | `external_directory` (outside session dir) | ASK always | Sandbox escape |
 | `doom_loop` | ASK always | Runaway-loop guard |
 | `question` (AskUserQuestion) | ASK always (cards, never auto) | Needs human judgment by definition |
 | `skill` (destructive/unknown) | ASK always | Unknown side effects |
 
 ## Rules
 
 - Deny rules (server config) override everything, always.
 - "Remember" (`always`) scoped per session by default; global-always requires explicit toggle (setting).
 - Critical paths (`rm` on home/root, credential files) → ASK regardless of allowlist.
 - Server `--auto` mode surfaced in UI banner (asks bypassed server-side except denys).
 - Failed reply (e.g. `PermissionNotFoundError` = settled elsewhere) → card refreshes, stays answerable (grinev rule).
 
 ## Approval needed
 
 User: approve table as-is, or adjust rows. Then it becomes the P2 permissions spec input.

 ## 1. Vision & goals
 
 - G1: Match then beat Claude mobile app quality for remote opencode sessions (doc 01).
